title: fix(ui): block .git in any case and keep repo root in path jump
body:
Follow-up to #75, two one-line changes in `FilesFragment.kt`.

**1. `.GIT` could still open the git directory.** The check compared the first path segment to `.git` exactly, but Android's shared storage is case-insensitive, so `.GIT` or `.Git/refs` resolved to the real `.git` directory. Now compared with `ignoreCase = true`.

**2. Navigate using the repo's own root path.** After validation it navigated to the canonical path. If `rootDir` goes through a symlink, that path doesn't start with `rootDir`, so the Files tab would show an Up row at the repo root (leading out of the repo) and a full path in the path bar. It now rebuilds the target from `rootDir` plus the validated relative path. The safety check itself is unchanged.

**Testing** (API 36 emulator, `github/gitignore` clone):
- Before: `.GIT` and `.Git/refs` opened the git directory.
- After: `.GIT`, `.Git/refs`, `.git`, `..` all show "Path is outside the repository".
- `community/DotNet`, `Global` (keyboard Done), `/` and an empty path still navigate correctly, no Up row at the root.
- `./gradlew assembleDebug testDebug` passes.

title: fix(ui): migrate simple text fields to TextFieldState for drag and drop
body:
Part of #58 (first of two PRs).

**Cause:** Compose only wires drag-and-drop text into the `TextFieldState`-based text fields. The `value`/`onValueChange` overload used throughout the app has no drop handling at all (confirmed in foundation 1.12.0-alpha03's classes: only `TextFieldDecoratorModifierNode` references it, not the legacy `CoreTextField` path). So dragging text in from another app did nothing, while long-press paste worked, on any device, not just ColorOS.

**This PR** migrates the 14 simple fields, the ones with no per-keystroke logic:
- Credential prompt: username, password
- Edit key password
- Checkout: new branch name
- Add remote: name, url
- Add account: label, username, token, instance URL
- Settings text values (git user name/email)
- Repo tags, rename repo
- Repo list search, clone sheet GitHub repo search

Password and token fields now use `OutlinedSecureTextField`, which also puts the keyboard in password mode. The account token's show/hide toggle maps to `textObfuscationMode`.

The remaining ~13 fields (commit message, rename branch/key/file, key generation, repo config, edit text, clone URL/local name, git console, file viewer search, Files path jump, repo detail search) have per-keystroke logic or text set from outside and follow in a second PR.

**Testing** (API 36 emulator, `./gradlew assembleDebug testDebug` passes):
- Repo search: filters, shows the no-match state, clear button and close/reopen reset the field.
- Tags: + disabled when empty, adding lowercases the tag and clears the field, tag saved.
- Rename repo: pre-filled, Rename disabled when empty, rename renames the folder.
- Settings user name: saves, reopens pre-filled, Cancel discards edits.
- Add account: Required errors on empty submit, token masked with reveal-last-typed, show/hide toggle, Custom type shows instance URL, account saved.
- Credential prompt: password masked; after Done the clone error changes from "no CredentialsProvider" to "not authorized", i.e. the typed credentials reach the request.
- Add remote: remote written to `.git/config` with the typed name and URL.
- Checkout: new branch created and checked out.
- Edit key password: masked, saves without errors.

**Not tested:**
- Actual drag-and-drop. `adb` can't start a real drag, so this needs a manual check with a mouse on the emulator or on a device.
- Clone sheet GitHub repo search (needs a connected GitHub account).

Observed while testing, not caused by this PR: after a checkout to a new branch, the branch chip in the repo header kept showing `refs/heads/main`.

title: fix(ui): migrate remaining text fields to TextFieldState for drag and drop
body:
Closes #58. Second half of the migration started in #77: the fields with per-keystroke logic or text set from code. After this, every typeable text field accepts dropped text.

**New helpers** (`ui/components/TextFieldStates.kt`):
- `onUserTextChange { newText -> }`: an `InputTransformation` that runs on user edits only (typing, paste, drop), matching the old `onValueChange` side effects. Programmatic changes don't fire it, so picking an author suggestion doesn't reopen the suggestions, and console history recall doesn't reset the history position.
- `rememberTextFieldStateFor(value)`: a `TextFieldState` that mirrors text owned by a ViewModel or parent. Outside changes are copied in with `SideEffect`. A first version used `LaunchedEffect` and dropped fast-typed characters in the clone sheet (its coroutine could run after the next keystroke and restore the previous value), found during testing and fixed.

**Migrated:** commit message and author, rename branch/key/file, key generation, repo config, edit-text dialog (cherry-pick etc.), clone URL and local name, git console, repo detail search, file viewer search, Files path jump. The three read-only dropdown anchors (merge options, account type, clone account) stay as they are, since nothing is typed into them.

**Testing** (API 36 emulator, `./gradlew assembleDebug testDebug` passes):
- Clone sheet: URL auto-fills the local name; editing the local name keeps every character; a real clone used the exact typed name and URL.
- Git console: Send runs the command and clears the field; history up/down; typing after a recall resets the history position; clear button.
- Commit: empty message error, typing clears it; amend fills and clears the last message; author suggestions open on typing and a picked author fills the field without reopening the list; a real commit recorded the typed message.
- Repo config: name and email written to `.git/config` as typed.
- Rename file / key: pre-filled, duplicate-name error clears on typing, rename applied (key renamed in both key folders).
- Key generation: duplicate-name error clears on typing; key length 2048 produced a 2048-bit key (public key length checked against the 4096 default).
- Rename branch: empty-name error clears on typing, new name passed to the rename.
- Cherry-pick (edit-text dialog): Required error, clears on typing, typed hash passed through.
- Repo detail search: drives the Files search, clear restores the list.
- File viewer commit search: filters.
- Files path jump: pre-fills the current path, keyboard Done submits.

Drag-and-drop itself uses the same mechanism as #77, which was checked manually.

**Existing bugs found while testing** (all reproduced on the build without this PR, not caused by it):
1. **Rename branch can break the repo.** The rename runs on the main thread. With no git email configured, JGit looks up the hostname for the reflog ident, the app crashes with `NetworkOnMainThreadException`, and `HEAD` is left pointing at a branch that no longer exists.
2. **File history search can crash.** Searching a file's commit history quickly can crash with `Key ... was already used` in the commits LazyColumn; the legacy `CommitsListAdapter` background filter can produce the same commit twice. Reproduced on both builds (crash on run 4 and 5 of repeated searches).
3. **Author suggestion popup takes key input.** In the commit dialog, once the popup opens, hardware/adb key events go to the popup; a space can pick a suggestion. Not verified with the on-screen keyboard.
4. **Cherry-pick with an unknown hash** shows a raw `NullPointerException` message instead of an "unknown commit" error.

title: fix(git-operation): rename and delete branches off the main thread
body:
Found while testing #78.

**Bug:** renaming a branch with no git email configured crashed the app with `NetworkOnMainThreadException`. The rename ran JGit on the main thread; JGit writes a reflog entry and, with no email set, builds a default ident from the device hostname (`InetAddress.getLocalHost()`), which Android forbids on the main thread. The crash happened partway through, so renaming the **checked-out** branch left `HEAD` pointing at a branch that no longer existed.

**Fix:**
- `RenameBranchDialog`: the JGit work moves into `renameRef()` and runs on `Dispatchers.IO` via the activity's `lifecycleScope` (the dialog dismisses straight away, so its own scope would cancel the work). The failure toast and branch list refresh happen back on the main thread.
- `MainActivity.deleteBranch`: same main-thread pattern for branch/tag delete, same fix.

**Testing** (API 36 emulator, repo with no git email configured):
- Before: renaming the checked-out branch crashed and left `HEAD` dangling (reproduced on the build without this change).
- After: renaming a branch works; renaming the **checked-out** branch updates `HEAD` to the new name, the ref exists, and the reflog entry is written (`root <root@localhost>`, JGit's default ident). No crash.
- Deleting a branch works and refreshes the list.
- Renaming to an existing name still shows the "can't rename" toast.
- `./gradlew compileDebugKotlin` passes.

title: fix(ui): stop stale commit search workers producing duplicate rows
body:
Found while testing #78.

**Bug:** searching commits quickly could crash the app with `IllegalArgumentException: Key "<commit id>" was already used` from the Compose commit list. Reproduced on the file viewer's Commits tab by repeatedly searching `first` (crash on run 4 to 5), on builds both with and without #78.

**Cause:** `CommitsListAdapter` filters on a single-thread executor. The worker read `mFilter`, `mAll` and `mFiltered` from fields, and `cancel(true)` only interrupts it. So a superseded worker could keep adding indices to the **next** filter's `mFiltered`, and a stale `postUpdate()` could start a second worker for the new filter. Either way the same commit was listed twice.

**Fix:** each filter run gets a generation number, bumped in `stopFiltering()` (every filter or list change goes through it, always under `mProgressLock`). Workers capture their own filter, lists and generation; a worker or posted update from an older generation exits without touching the current results. `isAccepted()` now takes the filter as a parameter instead of reading the field.

**Testing** (API 36 emulator):
- File viewer search repeated 10 times: no crash (previously crashed within 5), single correct result each time.
- Main Commits tab on a large repo (`github/gitignore`, thousands of commits, results stream in batches): search completes; rapid clear/retype 8 times during streaming, no crash; `Merge pull request #4803` returns exactly one row.
- `./gradlew assembleDebug` passes.

title: fix(ui): keep typing focus in the commit author field
body:
Found while testing #78.

**Bug:** in the commit dialog, the author suggestion list (a `DropdownMenu`) is focusable by default. As soon as the typed author matched someone, the popup opened and took input focus from the field: the keyboard closed, further key input went to the menu and was lost, and a space could select the highlighted author. Reproduced on builds both with and without #78.

**Fix:** `properties = PopupProperties(focusable = false)` on the suggestion menu, so input stays in the field.

**Testing** (API 36 emulator):
- Fast typing `Custom Author abcdefghij`: every character arrives (previously cut off after a few characters).
- Typing slowly, including spaces, while the popup is showing all authors: full text `Custom Author <ca@ex.co>`, keyboard stays open (previously a space picked a suggestion).
- Typing `Oct` and tapping the suggestion fills `The Octocat <octocat@nowhere.com>` and closes the list.
- Tapping outside the popup still dismisses it.
- `./gradlew assembleDebug` passes.

title: fix(git-operation): clear error for cherry-picking an unknown commit
body:
Found while testing #78.

**Bug:** cherry-picking a hash that isn't in the repo showed a raw `Attempt to invoke virtual method ... getName() on a null object reference` error. `resolve()` returns null for an unknown hash and that was passed straight to `cherryPick().include()`.

**Fix:**
- `CherryPickTask`: if `resolve()` returns null, fail with a new `error_unknown_commit` string, "Commit not found. Check the commit hash.", translated for all supported languages (ar, de, es, fr, iw, ja, ko, ru, zh-rCN).
- `RepoOpTask`: `BasicFunctions.showError(activity, errorTitleRes, errorRes)` takes the title first, but was called with the message first. So every task error set via `setError()` showed the message as the dialog title and "Error occurred" as the body. Arguments are now in the right order. If a task fails without a message, the previous call is kept (`ErrorDialog` can't load a `0` message resource). The exception path (`showException`) is unchanged.

**Testing** (API 36 emulator):
- Cherry-pick `abc`: before, raw NullPointerException text; after, title "Error occurred" with body "Commit not found. Check the commit hash."
- `./gradlew assembleDebug testDebug` passes.

title: fix(git-operation): renaming a tag crashed the app
body:
Found in the pre-release smoke test of the merged build.

**Bug:** renaming a tag from the branch chooser crashed the app with `NullPointerException: Attempt to get length of null array` at `RevTag.getFullMessage()`. The tag was fetched with `RevWalk.lookupTag()`, which returns an **unparsed** `RevTag`. This code is original; before #79 it crashed on the main thread the same way, and now it crashed from the background coroutine. Lightweight tags could never have worked either, since they point straight at a commit.

**Fix:** parse the target with `parseAny()`. An annotated tag is recreated with its message and tagger; a lightweight tag is recreated as a lightweight tag on the same object. `renameRef` now catches any exception, logs it and shows the existing "can't rename" toast, so nothing inside it can crash the app.

**Testing** (API 36 emulator, tags created with desktop git and pushed to the device):
- Annotated `v-test` renamed to `v-renamed`: no crash; `git cat-file` on the result shows a tag object on the same commit with the original message and tagger.
- Lightweight `v-light` renamed to `v-light2`: ref points directly at the same commit (still lightweight).
- Tag delete (`v-del`) works and the list refreshes.
- Crash checks included ACRA-caught exceptions, not just the crash log buffer.
- `./gradlew assembleDebug testDebug` passes.

title: fix(ui): keep git console history per repo
body:
Found in the pre-release smoke test.

**Bug:** the Console tab's history was shared between repos: output from a command run in one repo showed up in another repo's console. `RepoDetailViewModel` is activity-scoped (`ViewModelProvider(this@MainActivity)`) and reused for every repo opened, and it held a single list of console entries. A command still running when you switched repos also added its output to whichever repo was open when it finished.

**Fix:** console entries and the running flag are kept per repo id. `setRepo()` swaps in the current repo's history; each command's output is filed under the repo that ran it and only shown if that repo is still the current one; Clear clears only the current repo.

**Testing** (API 36 emulator):
- `status` in Spoon-Knife, then hw-custom's console is empty (previously showed Spoon-Knife's output).
- `branch` in hw-custom shows only its own output.
- Back in Spoon-Knife, only its `status` is shown.
- Clear in Spoon-Knife empties it, and hw-custom still shows its `branch` history.
- `./gradlew assembleDebug testDebug` passes.

Not tested: switching repos while a command is still running (commands finish too fast to switch in time); the code captures the repo id before the command starts, so the output goes to the repo that ran it.

title: fix: recover from EACCES when diffing or staging a media file
body:
## Summary

Fixes #48. Diffing or staging an image (or other recognized media type) sitting in a repo stored under "Make repos visible to other apps" threw a raw EACCES exception instead of a usable error.

**Root cause:** Android's MediaProvider blocks direct `java.io.File` access to image/video/audio files, even ones inside Gitling's own `Android/media/<pkg>/` directory, unless the app holds `READ_MEDIA_IMAGES` (API 33+) or `READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE` (older). Gitling never declared or requested either permission, so JGit's `FileTreeIterator`/`AddCommand`, which open working-tree files directly, hit `EACCES` before the app got a chance to ask.

**Fix:** the permission is requested lazily, only the moment a diff or stage operation actually hits this EACCES, then the operation retries automatically once granted, mirroring the existing auth-retry pattern already used for password prompts (`RepoRemoteOpTask`/`OnPasswordEntered`). No permission prompt ever appears for users who don't hit this path.

Two issues surfaced during on-device testing and are also fixed here:
- A repo-task-slot race where the retry could start before the failed attempt's slot was freed, surfacing a spurious "task already running" toast.
- An infinite retry loop: Android can report the permission as granted via `checkSelfPermission` while MediaProvider's own per-file check still denies that specific file (observed after choosing "Don't select more" in the system photo picker). The retry is capped at exactly one attempt to avoid looping on that state.

## Test plan

All verified on-device (emulator, API 36), not just read through:
- [x] Reproduced the original bug exactly (matching the issue's screenshots) on the unpatched build; confirmed via logcat the failure is `MediaProvider: calling app has PERMISSION_READ_IMAGES? false`.
- [x] Stage flow: permission denied -> tap stage -> system prompt appears -> grant ("Allow all") -> auto-retry -> "File has been added to stage", no stray error dialog.
- [x] Diff flow: same sequence -> diff renders correctly ("Binary files differ") after grant.
- [x] Partial-grant edge case ("Don't select more"): one clean, accurate error dialog, confirmed no infinite loop (logcat access-attempt count dropped from hundreds/sec to exactly 2 after the fix).
- [x] `./gradlew --no-daemon clean assembleDebug testDebug` passes.

title: fix: patch InputStream.readAllBytes() for JGit on Android API < 33
body:
## Summary

Fixes #52. Staging a file crashed with `NoSuchMethodError: No virtual method readAllBytes()[B in class Ljava/io/InputStream` on Android API < 33, since that method was only added to Android in API 33 and isn't backported by desugar_jdk_libs.

**Root cause** (confirmed by decompiling the actual JGit 7.3.0 jar this app ships, with javap): `AddCommand.call()` always calls `WorkingTreeIterator.getEntryContentLength()` when staging any entry, which calls `possiblyFilteredLength()`. That method calls `IO.readWholeStream()`, which calls the missing `InputStream.readAllBytes()`, specifically when a staged file is <= 64KB **and** either has a `.gitattributes` clean filter configured or needs EOL conversion. Plain binary files with no filter skip this path entirely and take a different, already-safe code path (`computeLength()`), so this refines the original report slightly, a large file alone does not trigger it.

This is a gap in the existing `JGitCompatClassVisitorFactory` ASM bytecode patch in `app/build.gradle.kts` (added for the v1.0.54 Android 12 fix), which already redirects `readNBytes(int)`, `readNBytes(byte[],int,int)`, and `transferTo(OutputStream)` to Java-8-compatible `StreamCompat` shims, but never covered this fourth method.

## Fix

- `StreamCompat.readAllBytes(InputStream)`, delegating to the existing `readNBytes(in, Integer.MAX_VALUE)` — this matches how the real JDK itself defines `readAllBytes()`, so no new logic to maintain.
- Extended the ASM patch to redirect the `()[B` descriptor the same way as the other three methods.

## Test plan

- [x] Reproduced live on an `android10_arm64` (API 29) emulator: repo with a `.gitattributes` containing `* text=auto` and a small text file, staged via the "+" button, exact same stack trace as the report.
- [x] Rebuilt with the fix, reinstalled on the same emulator, same repro now succeeds cleanly ("File has been added to stage"), zero exceptions in logcat.
- [x] `./gradlew --no-daemon clean assembleDebug testDebug` passes.

title: fix(ui): open the repo operations drawer from the same side as its button
body:
## Description

Closes #64. The menu (hamburger) button that opens the repo detail screen's operations drawer lives in the TopAppBar's `actions`, which Compose always renders at the layout-end (the right, in the common LTR case). `ModalNavigationDrawer`, though, always opens from the layout-start edge with no built-in option to open from the end, so the drawer opened on the opposite side from the button that opens it.

## Fix

Flip `LocalLayoutDirection` for just the `ModalNavigationDrawer` container to the inverse of the real direction, so its start edge becomes the visual end edge instead, matching wherever the button actually renders. Both the drawer's own content and the screen behind it are wrapped back to the real direction, so nothing else is mirrored.

Inverting the *current* direction (rather than hardcoding `Rtl`) is the logically correct approach for an RTL locale too, rather than reintroducing the same mismatch in reverse. See the Testing section below for an important caveat on verifying that specific case.

## Type of change

- [x] Bug fix

## Testing

`./gradlew --no-daemon clean assembleDebug testDebug` passes.

### LTR (default, the reported bug)

Verified on a Pixel 6 emulator (API 36):
- The drawer now opens flush against the right edge (rounded free edge on the left) directly under the menu button, both mid-animation and fully open.
- The drawer's own content and the screen behind it render normally, not mirrored.
- Tapping the scrim closes the drawer.
- Tapping an operation (New Branch) still dispatches correctly and auto-closes the drawer.

### RTL (Arabic)

Confirmed `MainActivity` genuinely received an RTL system configuration (`[ar,ar_SA] ldrtl`, verified via `dumpsys activity`, not just assumed), but the app's layout stayed LTR regardless. Root cause, separate from this PR: `AndroidManifest.xml` never declares `android:supportsRtl="true"`, so no screen in the app mirrors for RTL locales today, this isn't specific to this change. `LocalLayoutDirection.current` will therefore always read `Ltr` in this app as it currently stands, no matter the device language.

So this fix's RTL-inversion branch is logically correct and will do the right thing automatically if `supportsRtl` is ever added, but that branch is currently unreachable in practice, since nothing in the app enters it yet. Flagging `supportsRtl` separately rather than bundling an app-wide RTL-mirroring change into this fix.

title: fix(git-operation): resolve credentials per remote, not per repo
body:
## Description

Closes #59. A repo's saved username/password (set via the password prompt's "save password" checkbox) is stored once per repo, not once per remote, so a repo with both a GitHub and a GitLab remote could only authenticate one of them correctly, the repo-level credential applied unconditionally to every remote regardless of host.

## Root cause

`RepoOpTask.setCredentials()` already looked up a connected Account by host (`AccountManager.findAccountForRemoteUrl`), but only as a fallback when the repo-level credential was blank, and always against `mRepo.getRemoteURL()` (the repo's primary/origin URL) rather than the URL of the remote actually being pushed/pulled/fetched. `GitCommandEngine` (the git console's `fetch`/`pull` commands) had the same bug duplicated separately.

## Fix

Try the host-matched Account first, for the URL of the specific remote in play. Fall back to the repo-level saved credential only for a remote whose host has no connected account. Adds `Repo.getRemoteURL(String)` to resolve an arbitrary named remote's URL from git config, since the existing `getRemoteURL()`/`getRemoteOriginURL()` only ever return the primary remote.

## Type of change

- [x] Bug fix

## Testing

`./gradlew --no-daemon clean assembleDebug testDebug` passes.

### Selection-logic verification (local fake servers)

Verified on a Pixel 6 emulator with two local HTTP servers logging `Authorization` headers, one host matched to a connected Custom account, one not, set as two remotes on a test repo. Both the drawer's Fetch action and the git console's fetch command correctly selected the account's credentials for the matched host and correctly fell back to the repo-level saved credential for the unmatched host.

### Real end-to-end verification (live Gitea and GitLab)

To confirm this isn't just correct selection but an actual successful fix, repeated the test against two real, disposable repos (created and deleted via each host's API for this test, gitea.com and gitlab.com), comparing the pre-fix code against this fix on the identical setup:

- Repo-level saved credential: a Gitea personal access token.
- Connected Account: a GitLab personal access token (built-in `GitLab` account type, host-matched automatically).
- Remote `origin` → the Gitea repo (no connected account for this host, should fall back to the repo-level credential).
- Remote `other` → the GitLab repo (connected account exists, should override the repo-level credential).

**Pre-fix (`develop`):** `Fetch All` fetched `origin` (Gitea) successfully, since the repo-level credential happened to be valid there, but failed `other` (GitLab) with a real `https://gitlab.com/.../gitling-cred-test.git: not authorized` from GitLab's live server, then prompted for new credentials. This is the exact bug reported in #59, reproduced against a real host.

**This fix:** `Fetch All` succeeded for both. `branch -r` in the console afterward showed both `origin/main` and `other/main` as real fetched remote-tracking branches, versus only `origin/main` on the pre-fix build.

title: fix(git-operation): don't crash opening Commits tab on a repo with no commits
body:
## Description

Found while testing PR #62. Opening the Commits tab on a freshly initialized repo (no commits yet, unborn HEAD) threw:

```
Attempt to invoke virtual method 'int org.eclipse.jgit.lib.AnyObjectId.hashCode()' on a null object reference
```

`GetCommitGraphTask.loadGraph()` resolves HEAD and passes it straight into `walk.parseCommit()` without a null check. On an unborn HEAD, `repository.resolve("HEAD")` returns null, and JGit's `parseCommit(null)` throws deep inside `PlotWalk` rather than something catchable, so it surfaces as a raw error dialog instead of an empty commit list.

`GetCommitTask` (the plain linear per-file history, used e.g. by `ViewFileActivity`'s commit-history tab) doesn't have this bug, since it goes through JGit's `LogCommand`, which throws a catchable `NoHeadException` for the same case.

## Fix

Skip `markStart()` when HEAD is unborn, leaving the walk with nothing marked, so the task returns a normal empty `PlotCommitList` instead of failing. `CommitsListAdapter.resetCommit()`'s callback already handles a non-null empty list correctly (renders an empty commit list); it only skipped updating on a null result, which also left the loading state stuck on top of showing the error dialog.

## Type of change

- [x] Bug fix

## Testing

`./gradlew --no-daemon clean assembleDebug testDebug` passes. Verified on a Pixel 6 emulator (API 36): before the fix, initializing a local repo and opening its Commits tab showed the error dialog above; after the fix, the same repo's Commits tab loads with an empty list under both "Current branch" and "All branches", no crash.

title: fix: remove double execute() in HTTP interceptor chain causing media uploads to fail
body:
## Summary

Media uploads (`POST /api/v2/media`) fail intermittently — especially when uploading multiple files at once. Single uploads sometimes succeed, mass uploads almost always fail.

### Root Cause

The `HttpSend` interceptor in `AppComponent` calls `execute(request)` **twice** per request:

```kotlin
// BEFORE (broken)
plugin(HttpSend).intercept { request ->
    with(session) { intercept(request) }        // execute() #1 — NO Bearer token
    with(authInterceptor) { intercept(request) } // execute() #2 — with Bearer token
}
```

`Session.intercept()` sets the server URL host and then calls `execute(request)`, which **sends the actual network request without the Authorization header**. The server receives an unauthenticated request and returns `401`/`500`. Because `expectSuccess = true` is configured on the `HttpClient`, ktor throws a `ServerResponseException` on the 500 response — so `AuthInterceptor.intercept()` on the next line is **never reached**.

For multipart uploads in particular, even in cases where the exception doesn't propagate, the first `execute()` call consumes the streaming request body. The second `execute()` in `AuthInterceptor` then sends an empty body to the server, which rejects it.

I was able to confirm this by adding request-level logging on the server side. Every failed upload arrived with `Authorization: (missing)`. The few that eventually succeeded arrived with `Authorization: Bearer <token>` — sent by `AuthInterceptor` in the rare cases where the first execute did not throw.

### Fix

Inline the URL-host substitution from `Session` directly into the `HttpSend` interceptor block, **without calling `execute()`**. Then delegate to `AuthInterceptor.intercept()` which adds the Bearer token and performs a single `execute()`:

```kotlin
// AFTER (fixed)
plugin(HttpSend).intercept { request ->
    session.credentials.value?.let { creds ->
        if (request.url.host != "api.fedisea.surf" && request.url.host != "pixelfed.org") {
            request.url.set(host = Url(creds.serverUrl).host)
        }
    }
    with(authInterceptor) { intercept(request) }
}
```

`Session.intercept()` (the member extension on `Sender`) is no longer needed and is removed along with its now-unused imports.

## Test plan

- [ ] Single photo upload succeeds
- [ ] Single video upload succeeds
- [ ] Mass upload (multiple photos + videos selected at once) succeeds without any 401/500 errors
- [ ] Token refresh flow still works (expired token → refresh → retry)
- [ ] Login / logout unaffected

This PR resolves #106 ("Backdated SMS transactions can cause account balance drift"). It synthesizes the initial PR #108 implementation with database-level optimizations to establish a robust, thread-safe, and atomic balance recalculation mechanism.

1. **Database Layer (`AccountBalanceDao.kt`)**

body:
## Overview
This patch primarily addresses a critical thread-migration crash on Vivo/Funtouch OS devices, introduces support for 4K/Ultrawide video decoding, and adds full Spanish localization.

## 🛠️ Bug Fixes & Stability
* **Funtouch OS Thread Migration Fix:** Forced ExoPlayer to explicitly bind to `Looper.getMainLooper()`. This prevents aggressive OEM operating systems from migrating the player to a background thread, which previously caused a fatal crash and a fallback to the default system wallpaper.
* **Visibility Debounce:** Wrapped the `onVisibilityChanged` callback in a debounced Coroutine (`delay(33L)`). This prevents race conditions and battery drain if the user rapidly spams the device power button or lock screen.
* **Surface Lifecycle:** Adjusted the GL Surface wait timeout to 3.0 seconds to accommodate slower hardware decoders waking from deep sleep.

## ✨ Enhancements
* **4K / Ultrawide Support:** Increased the `maxPixels` decoding limit to 12,000,000, allowing modern ultra-high-resolution videos to be used.
* **Spanish Localization:** Added complete Spanish strings (`values-es`).
* **UI Clarity:** Changed all instances of "Delete" to "Remove" in the playlist UI to clarify that videos are only removed from the app's queue, not deleted from the user's actual device storage.
* **Debug Tools:** Added an opt-in, privacy-safe `FileLogger` with a Share Intent to assist in debugging future OEM-specific hardware quirks.

# Importing Takeout data (ZIP / individual files) — fix for localized file names

> Fixes issue: [#28 — "import my subscription or history watch issue"](https://github.com/lau-luna/PlayTube/issues/28)

## Problem

The import logic relied on **hardcoded English file names**. The original `importHistory()` and `importSubscriptions()` matched files exclusively by these names:

```kotlin
getStreamForFile(uri, listOf("watch-history.json", "MyActivity.json"))  // history
getStreamForFile(uri, listOf("subscriptions.csv"))                      // subscriptions
```

However, Google Takeout **localizes the exported file names based on the account language**, so they don't always match those hardcoded names.

For example, with a Google account in Spanish, Takeout exports:

```
Takeout/
└── YouTube y YouTube Music
    ├── historial de videos
    │   ├── historial de búsquedas.json
    │   └── historial de reproducciones.json
    └── suscripciones
        └── suscripciones.csv
```

As a result, the import **failed** (files not found) or, when importing a **ZIP**, `getStreamForFile` returned the first file matching the extension — which could end up importing the **search history** (`historial de búsquedas.json`) instead of the **watch history** (`historial de reproducciones.json`).

## Changes

Only **one file** was modified:

- `app/src/main/java/com/arslandaim/playtube/workers/ImportWorker.kt`

### 1. `importHistory()` — filename matching replaced with smart detection

Before:

```kotlin
val inputStream = getStreamForFile(uri, listOf("watch-history.json", "MyActivity.json"))
```

After:

```kotlin
val inputStream = getWatchHistoryStream(uri)
```

### 2. `importSubscriptions()` — filename matching replaced with name preference + fallback

Before:

```kotlin
val inputStream = getStreamForFile(uri, listOf("subscriptions.csv"))
```

After:

```kotlin
val inputStream = getSubscriptionsStream(uri)
```

### 3. Old `getStreamForFile` removed, new methods added

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| `getWatchHistoryStream(uri)` | Watch-history selection. Standalone `.json` → returned directly; ZIP → finds the correct JSON and opens it. |
| `getSubscriptionsStream(uri)` | Subscriptions selection. Standalone `.csv` → returned directly; ZIP → prefers a `subscriptions.csv`-named entry, falls back to the first `.csv`. |
| `openZipEntry(uri, entryName)` | Re-opens the ZIP and seeks to the chosen entry, returning its `InputStream`. |
| `isWatchHistoryFileName(name)` | Fast filename-based detection (`watch-history.json`, or containing `watch` + `history`). |
| `isWatchHistoryJson(stream)` | Content-based detection (language-independent), sampling up to 30 items and applying majority rule. |

The old `getStreamForFile(uri, targetFileNames)` method was removed.

### 4. How the watch-history file inside the ZIP is chosen

Priority order:

1. **By name**: if a `watch-history.json`-style file exists, use it.
2. **By content**: if no name matches, inspect each `.json` and classify it by its structure.
3. **Fallback**: if nothing found, use the first `.json`.

### 5. Content-based classification (language-independent)

Google localizes the JSON *text* but **not the field names** (always English). That's what allows distinguishing the files by structure:

- **Watch history** → items have `subtitles` (the channel) and no `description` / `details`.
- **Search history** → items have no `subtitles` and do have `description` and/or `details`.

Real example of **watch history** (has `subtitles`, no `details`):

```json
{
  "title": "Has visto Penpals - PENPALS (1997.07.20) [Full Album]",
  "titleUrl": "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=h8KmybW-_hg",
  "subtitles": [{ "name": "GreatLee", "url": "..." }],
  "time": "2026-09-05T02:03:29.999Z"
}
```

Real example of **search history** (has `description` and `details`, no `subtitles`):

```json
{
  "title": "Has visto C01ILDV...",
  "titleUrl": "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qR0w7bP9jBM",
  "description": "Visto a las 1:08 a.m.",
  "time": "2026-09-05T01:08:06.388Z",
  "details": [{ "name": "De los anuncios de Google" }]
}
```

### [`v0.14.0`](https://redirect.github.com/saket/telephoto/releases/tag/0.14.0)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/saket/telephoto/compare/0.13.0...0.14.0)

New changes

-   Support for Coil 3 (`me.saket.telephoto:zoomable-image-coil3:{version}`)
-   Added state restoration of zoom & pan values across orientation changes
-   Zoom & pan transformations now render synchronously instead of lagging behind by a frame, eliminating flicker during layout size changes
-   Added [ZoomableImageState#isImageDisplayedInFullQuality](https://redirect.github.com/saket/telephoto/blob/5ec5625e6d90a5fe18175195abc0324472141886/zoomable-image/core/src/main/kotlin/me/saket/telephoto/zoomable/ZoomableImageState.kt#L33-L37)
-   Added new APIs for custom `ZoomableImageSource` implementations:
    -   [SubSamplingImageSource#canBeSubSampled()](https://redirect.github.com/saket/telephoto/blob/5ec5625e6d90a5fe18175195abc0324472141886/zoomable-image/sub-sampling-image/src/main/kotlin/me/saket/telephoto/subsamplingimage/internal/imageChecks.kt#L11-L14)
    -   [SubSamplingImageSource#exists()](https://redirect.github.com/saket/telephoto/blob/5ec5625e6d90a5fe18175195abc0324472141886/zoomable-image/sub-sampling-image/src/main/kotlin/me/saket/telephoto/subsamplingimage/internal/imageChecks.kt#L28-L29)

Bug fixes

-   [#​95](https://redirect.github.com/saket/telephoto/issues/95): Removed explicit recycling of bitmap decoders
-   [#​97](https://redirect.github.com/saket/telephoto/issues/97): Added protection against `NaN` velocities
-   [#​99](https://redirect.github.com/saket/telephoto/issues/99): Added handling for non-existent content URIs to prevent crashes
-   [#​110](https://redirect.github.com/saket/telephoto/issues/110): Added workaround for a Compose UI issue with unknown color spaces
-   `ZoomableImage()` will now display its `contentDescription` even if the image isn't loaded yet
-   Content alignment can now be updated even if the image is zoomed in
-   Prevented multiple buffering of `SubSamplingImageSource.rawSource()`

Deprecations

-   `ZoomableContentLocation#size()` is no longer used
-   `SubSamplingImageState#isImageLoaded` → `isImageDisplayed`
-   `SubSamplingImageState#isImageLoadedInFullQuality` → `isImageDisplayedInFullQuality`
-   `ZoomableState#setContentLocation()` → `setContentLocationSynchronously()`

</details>

title: Fix/navigation can pop
body:

title: fix: fix device pairing approve command and reduce requestId churn
body:
## Summary / 概要

Fixes two issues that caused `unknown requestId` errors when approving device pairing.

| | EN | JA |
|---|---|---|
| **Problem 1** | Approve/reject command used `tr '{' '\n' \| grep` to parse pretty-printed JSON — `requestId` and `deviceId` land on separate lines so the subshell returns empty, and `openclaw devices approve ""` fails with `unknown requestId` | `tr '{' '\n'` で pretty-print JSON を分割すると `requestId` と `deviceId` が別行になり抽出失敗 → `unknown requestId` |
| **Problem 2** | `PairingRequiredCard` auto-retried every 6 s, continuously generating a new `requestId` on the server before the user could run the approve command | 6秒ごとに再接続して `requestId` が変わり続け、コマンドを実行する前に古い ID が無効になっていた |

## Changes / 変更内容

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `values*/strings.xml` (×9) | Replace `tr/grep/cut` with `jq -r '.pending[] \| select(.deviceId == "…") \| .requestId'` |
| `PairingRequiredCard.kt` | `PAIRING_AUTO_RETRY_MS`: `6_000` → `5 * 60_000` (5 min) |

## Test plan / テスト手順

- [x] Reproduced `unknown requestId` error with old command
- [x] Ran fixed jq command — `Approved <deviceId> (<requestId>)` confirmed
- [x] `./gradlew :app:compileStandardDebugKotlin` passes

**EN:** After approving, tap the Refresh button for an immediate reconnect.
**JA:** 承認後は「再確認」ボタンで即時再接続できます。

Closes #596

title: 🔄 Upstream Parity: fix(android): auto-resume pairing approval
body:
- Source
Commit 911f9a104c from upstream android repo
- Why
To tighten the retry behavior when a gateway connection fails due to pending pairing approval
- Adaptation
Added `PAIRING_AUTO_RETRY_MS` and `LaunchedEffect` block to `SetupGuideScreen` and `PairingRequiredCard` in this repo's implementation to auto retry when pairing approval is required. Handled `attemptedConnect` correctly inside the `LaunchedEffect` in `SetupGuideScreen.kt`.
- Excluded upstream behavior
Excluded purely stylistic UI restructuring changes and only ported the core logic. Excluded modifications to `ConnectTabScreen` and `OnboardingFlow` as their functionality is implemented in different files (`SetupGuideScreen`, `PairingRequiredCard`) in this codebase.
- Verification

title: fix(android): replace device identity keystore flow
body:
## Summary

This replaces the current Android device identity implementation with a  file-backed identity store based on Ed25519 key generation via Bouncy Castle.

The previous implementation used Tink + AndroidKeysetManager + public key extraction from the exported keyset. In practice, that flow could fail silently during initialization or public key extraction, leaving `deviceId` null while the app still proceeded into gateway connect.

That caused setup failures like: `Gateway error: missing device identity id`

## Root cause

`GatewaySession` requires a valid device identity before sending `connect`, but the old `DeviceIdentity` flow could produce a partially initialized object:
- signer missing or unusable
- public key extraction failing
- `deviceId == null`

This patch replaces that with a file-backed identity model:
- generate Ed25519 keypair directly
- persist identity to `openclaw/identity/device.json`
- derive `deviceId` from SHA-256 of the raw public key
- validate loaded identity before reuse

## Changes

- remove `DeviceIdentity.kt`
- move device identity data + persistence into `DeviceIdentityStore.kt`
- generate and sign Ed25519 keys directly with Bouncy Castle
- keep `publicKeyBase64Url()` and signature verification behavior in the store
- update `DebugHandler` to use the new identity shape

## Validation

Tested locally by:
- building `app:compileStandardDebugKotlin`
- building/installing debug APK
- reproducing setup on two real Android devices (Google Pixel 10 Pro and Poco X7 Pro) 
- confirming the patched app successfully connects where the previous build failed with:
  - `Gateway error: missing device identity id`

## Notes

This intentionally avoids including local-only build helpers such as `local.properties` or dummy Firebase config used during local verification.

title: fix: await connect nonce even on loopback host
body:
## Summary

The gateway handshake sends a `connect.challenge` nonce that the client must sign, for both local and remote gateways (required unconditionally since the upstream change around v2026.4.11). `awaitConnectNonce()` currently short-circuits to `null` whenever the endpoint host is loopback, on the assumption that loopback is always a trusted local gateway that doesn't issue a challenge.

That assumption breaks when `127.0.0.1` is actually an SSH port-forward (or similar tunnel) to a **remote** gateway. The server still sends `connect.challenge` with a `nonce`, the client ignores it, and the server rejects the `connect` frame with:

```
invalid connect params: at /device: must have required property 'nonce'
```

Reproduces reliably over `ssh -L 18789:localhost:18789 <remote>` pointed at any gateway running a recent upstream version.

Fixes #296.

## Changes

Remove the `isLoopbackHost` short-circuit in `awaitConnectNonce()`. The existing 2-second timeout preserves the original ergonomic for genuinely-local dev gateways that omit `connect.challenge` — they fall through to `null` and the handshake proceeds exactly as before.

`isLoopbackHost` itself is retained; it is still used by `normalizeCanvasHostUrl`.

## Relation to #441

Issue #441 already documents that "loopback = trusted local gateway" is no longer a safe assumption at the TLS layer. This PR applies the same reasoning to the nonce handshake.

## Test plan

- [x] Node connects over SSH tunnel to remote gateway at `127.0.0.1:18789` — previously failed with "must have required property 'nonce'"
- [x] Node still connects to a genuinely-local dev gateway that omits `connect.challenge` (2 s timeout fires; nonce is `null`; flow unchanged)
- [x] `FIREBASE_ENABLED=false ./gradlew lintStandardDebug` — BUILD SUCCESSFUL
- [x] `FIREBASE_ENABLED=false ./gradlew clean testStandardDebugUnitTest` — BUILD SUCCESSFUL (125 tests, 0 failures)

title: fix: resolve Crashlytics ANR and Receiver-not-registered crashes
body:
## Summary / 概要

Firebase Crashlytics の過去7日間のログ(2026-03-25〜2026-04-01)を分析し、修正可能な2件のバグを修正します。

| Issue ID | Type | Affected Users | Versions | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `d73d9f7a` | FATAL | 4 users | 1.4.2–2.4.4 | `unregisterReceiver` を try-catch で保護 |
| `25d390c5` | ANR | 2 users (FRESH) | 2.4.7 | `MarkdownText` → `ChatMarkdown` に置き換え |

---

### Fix 1: `OpenClawAssistantService.onShutdown` — Receiver not registered

**EN:** `onShutdown()` called `unregisterReceiver(debugReceiver)` unconditionally. If `onCreate()` was never reached (e.g. service killed before initialization) or if `onShutdown` fires more than once, the receiver is not registered and Android throws `IllegalArgumentException`, crashing the app. Wrapped in try-catch.

**JA:** `onShutdown()` で `unregisterReceiver(debugReceiver)` を無条件に呼び出していた。`onCreate()` が完了する前にシャットダウンされた場合などレシーバー未登録状態でクラッシュしていた。try-catch で保護。

### Fix 2: `ChatActivity` ANR — synchronous Markdown parsing on main thread

**EN:** The AI message bubbles in `ChatActivity` used `MarkdownText` which wraps the `mikepenz` Markdown library. That library calls `MarkdownParser.buildMarkdownTreeFromString()` synchronously on the main thread, which ANRed on a Redmi Note 9 Pro with a long AI response. Replaced with the project's own `ChatMarkdown` composable, which uses `remember(text)` to cache parsed blocks and avoids any heavy library traversal. `ChatMessageViews.kt` already uses `ChatMarkdown` for the same purpose.

**JA:** `ChatActivity` のAI返答バブルに `MarkdownText`（mikepenzライブラリのラッパー）を使用していた。このライブラリはメインスレッドでMarkdown構文解析を同期実行するため、長い返答でANRが発生していた。プロジェクト独自の `ChatMarkdown`（`remember(text)` でキャッシュ済み）に置き換えた。`ChatMessageViews.kt` では既に同じ理由で `ChatMarkdown` を使用している。

We discovered a CC (Configuration Compatibility) Bug in your library. This issue is caused by the abnormal display of `android:foreground` in Android API levels below 23. As shown in the example below, when running on API 22, clicking the corresponding button does not trigger the click effect, whereas it works correctly on APIs above 22.
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d5790d29-c374-4206-9338-1caf9c3b2b36)
Our repair tool recommends replacing `android:foreground` with `android:background` to ensure compatibility with lower API levels. Furthermore, we have tested this fix on multiple higher API levels, and it has proven to be effective. Below is the result after applying the fix. We believe this is an important indicator to determine whether the click operation is performed correctly, so we submit this PR. Looking forward to your reply!
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/342ba44f-aece-481a-8607-421368760a7c)

title: fix(tracker): harden ActivityWatcherService foreground start against platform rejection
body:
## Summary

Supersedes #221 (closed, stale/conflicting against current `dev/v10`).

Re-investigated the original PR's scope against current `dev/v10` before writing any code:

- **Already done, more thoroughly, by other work:** the reviewer's core request on #221 -- deriving the foreground-service type from *active tracking configuration/tier* rather than permission possession -- is already implemented via `TrackerService.foregroundServiceTypeCandidates()` / `resolveInitialPolicyTier()`, with dedicated tests (`ForegroundServiceTypeCandidatesTest`, `TierConfigurationTest`) and full `SecurityException`/`ForegroundServiceStartNotAllowedException` handling (`tryStartForeground`) plus a user-visible failure notification. Nothing to port here.
- **Verified inapplicable, dropped from scope:** `Service.onTimeout(int, int)` (Android 15+) only fires for `dataSync`/`mediaProcessing` foreground-service types per current platform docs, not `location`/`health`/`specialUse` -- which is all `TrackerService` and `ActivityWatcherService` declare. Implementing it would be dead code the system never calls.
- **Real remaining gap (this PR):** `ActivityWatcherService.startForegroundCompat()` had **no exception handling at all** around `startForeground()`, unlike `TrackerService`'s already-hardened equivalent. This service can be started from background contexts (e.g. after an activity-recognition transition), so an Android 12+ `ForegroundServiceStartNotAllowedException` or a `SecurityException` on the declared type would crash it with an uncaught exception.

## Changes

- Extracted the tolerant-start logic into two small, directly testable top-level functions in `ActivityWatcherService.kt`, mirroring `TrackerService`'s pattern:
  - `isForegroundServiceStartRestriction(sdkInt, exceptionClassName)` -- pure string/SDK check, plain JUnit5 test (`IsForegroundServiceStartRestrictionTest`).
  - `startForegroundTolerant(sdkInt, tag, start)` -- try/catch + `Reporter` logging, Robolectric test (`StartForegroundTolerantTest`).
- `onCreate()` now calls `stopSelf()` and returns instead of continuing setup when the foreground declaration is rejected.

## Verification

- `.\gradlew.bat :tracker:engine:testDebugUnitTest` (no filters, full module): **BUILD SUCCESSFUL**, 955 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors (includes the 7 new test cases).
- Branch rebased onto current `dev/v10` tip (post source-evidence-tracking refactor); no conflicts.

title: fix(import): handle UNIQUE constraint conflicts during database import
body:
Fixes #142

## Approach
- copy the incoming SQLite file into app-private cache before opening it read/write
- serialize import workers and hold the Room write transaction only for remap + merge
- shift AUTOINCREMENT integer primary keys above target maxima, updating every source foreign-key reference in the copied database
- insert compatible rows with duplicate business keys skipped, while typed `DatabaseImportResult` failures roll back the complete database-file import
- preserve SQLite value types, including BLOBs, during row copies

## Verification
- `:feature:import-export:testDebugUnitTest`: 272 passed
- `:app:compileDebugKotlin`: passed (including Hilt worker wiring)
- regression tests cover parent/child ID collisions, secondary UNIQUE collisions, rollback after FK failure, BLOB preservation, and skipped-schema FK consistency
- `:core:base:testDebugUnitTest`: 845 passed; the unrelated pre-existing `MainBaselineMigrationTest` logger fixture open failure remains reproducible with no core/base changes in this PR

title: fix(build): missing junit5-jupiter version.ref breaks :stats:engine KMP commonTest
body:
## Problem
`:stats:engine:commonTest` failed to resolve dependencies:
```
Could not find org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter:.
Required by: project :stats:engine
```

## Root cause
`junit5-jupiter` and `junit5-jupiter-params` in the version catalog had no `version.ref`, relying on the `junit5-bom` platform to supply a version. That works for standard Android test configs (a convention plugin auto-injects the BOM), but Kotlin Multiplatform's `commonTest.dependencies` DSL does not support `platform()`/BOMs at all — so `:stats:engine` (a KMP module using the bare aliases directly) resolved with an empty version.

## Fix
Add the missing `version.ref = "junit5"` to both aliases. Harmless for modules that also apply the BOM (explicit version simply matches/overrides).

## Verification
Ran `:stats:engine:allTests`, `:stats:api:allTests`, `:core:model:allTests` (the other KMP modules), and `:core:testing:testDebugUnitTest` (the module that already applied the BOM manually) — all BUILD SUCCESSFUL, no regressions.

title: fix(ui): 修复工具栏自定义配置在重启后失效
body:
## 问题与修复

在手机上使用工具栏自定义面板时发现，调整工具按钮及排列顺序后，退出应用并结束后台进程，再次打开会恢复默认工具栏。

配置实际上已经写入 `brush_groups` 的 `pinned_tools`，问题出在启动恢复：工具栏的读取逻辑位于 `loadBrushParams()` 末尾，前面读取 `brush_params` 或 `tool_brush_states` 时，只要其中一项不存在就会提前返回，导致工具栏配置未被加载。这也解释了为什么已有完整笔刷缓存的安装环境可能不受影响。

本次将工具栏配置恢复从笔刷参数加载中分离：

- 将现有读取逻辑提取为 `loadPinnedTools()`，与 `savePinnedTools()` 对应
- 在 `appContext` 初始化后的 `syncSettingsFromPrefs()` 中调用，使工具栏随应用设置独立恢复

仅修改两个 Kotlin 文件，保留原有配置键与解析方式，已有配置无需迁移或重新保存。

## 回归注意点

- **缓存缺失**：工具栏恢复不能依赖用户是否调整过笔刷参数，需覆盖两类笔刷缓存分别缺失及同时缺失的情况
- **默认值与空列表**：没有保存记录时沿用默认工具栏；用户明确取消全部按钮时，应保留空列表，不能回退默认值
- **顺序与升级兼容**：保留已保存的工具顺序，覆盖安装后应直接读取旧配置
- **进程重启**：验证时需结束应用进程后重新启动，仅关闭面板或切换前后台无法证明持久化恢复正常

本次只调整设置恢复时机，不涉及绘画引擎、JNI、录制格式或渲染热路径。

## 验证与测试

基于主线 `981e48ed`，已逐行审阅本次修改，并完成以下验证：

- [x] 架构检查及 `git diff --check`
- [x] `:app:compileDebugKotlin`
- [x] `:app:testDebugUnitTest`：544 项，0 失败
- [x] `:app:lintDebug`：沿用仓库 baseline，22 项 warning，无未过滤的 error
- [x] `:app:assembleDebug`
- [x] Android API 30 模拟器：五组进程重启对照，修复前四组异常、一组正常；修复后五组全部通过，覆盖缓存缺失、按钮选择与顺序、全部取消按钮
- [x] 覆盖安装修复包后直接恢复旧配置，无需重新设置
- [x] 一加 Ace 3 / PJE110（Android 14）手动测试：退出重进后，工具按钮和顺序均正常保留，未再出现恢复默认的现象

模拟器验证通过实际保存入口写入配置，结束进程后启动真实 MainActivity 检查恢复结果。真机也复现了修复前的问题；修复后的真机结论以本人手动测试为准。自动化真机升级检查期间与手动修改配置重叠，该次断言未计作通过。

title: fix(animation): 修复自动建帧后洋葱皮不刷新
body:
## 变更概述

在曝光延长区落笔自动建立关键帧时，播放头时间没有变化，画布可能继续显示上上帧的洋葱皮，上一帧反而不出现。本次让关键帧结构变化后立即重新计算洋葱皮及其覆盖范围。

问题来自 #68 作者的[附带复现说明](https://github.com/LanRhyme/ReveriePaint/pull/68#issuecomment-5995918833)，用户在主线 1.4.3 也遇到；这不是 #68 引入的问题，也不替代它的帧转图层功能。

- 根因是 ReverieCore 自持的 `m_strokeOnionCache` 和覆盖范围未失效；现有 `flushOnionSkinCaches` 只清 Krita 图层缓存，无法修复这份缓存
- 在新增、重复、删除、复制、克隆、移动关键帧成功后调用现有失效函数，共增加 9 行 C++
- 保留原有撤销重做和缩略图精准失效行为，不修改 Kotlin/JNI 接口，不增加笔画或逐帧扫描
- 基于主线 `49f08196`，完整重建并更新 `libreverie_jni.so`

## 验证与测试

- [x] 原生完整构建：40 个编译/链接步骤通过，303 个 JNI 导出均保留，依赖及强符号检查通过
- [x] 一加 Ace 3（PJE110，Android 14 / API 34）真机引擎 A/B：相同 13 项测试中，旧库 10 项失败、3 项对照通过；修复库 13 项全部通过
- [x] 实际 Kotlin 自动建帧入口及原生笔画：建帧后、笔画进行中、抬笔后正确显示上一帧，旧残影消失，新笔画写入正常
- [x] 播放头静止时重复、删除、复制、克隆、移动帧；建帧撤销重做；重复建帧不增加撤销项
- [x] 手动建帧、关闭洋葱皮、建帧后切换时刻的对照
- [x] APK 有效载荷核对：A/B 仅原生库不同，55 个 Qt 库保留原版
- [x] `git diff --check`
- [ ] `:app:compileDebugKotlin`：两次尝试均因本机 JVM 原生内存分配失败退出，降低堆大小、并发及 GC 线程后仍未完成；不计为通过

真机测试使用同一份已编译的隔离 Kotlin 宿主，在实际 `renderHandler` 调用引擎并比较渲染像素，不是 mock，也不是完整触屏操作。宿主含其他开发中的 Kotlin 代码，本次没有调用其图案填充接口，不作为发布 APK。旧版撤销测试在初始洋葱皮断言即失败，不能据此单独断言旧版撤销实现有问题。

本次未重新执行主应用 Gradle 单元测试、完整 APK 构建或全量 Lint，未做真机手动触屏回归。详细根因、像素对照及手工复现步骤见 `docs/ONION-AUTO-KEYFRAME.md`。

title: fix(color): 修复超大系统字体下 HSV 数值文本换行导致的色环布局错乱
body:
## 问题

Fixes #61

超大系统字体下, 色轮/方块/滑杆页的 HSV 百分比取到 100% 时横向放不下而换行, 导致滑杆行高突变、整块色环面板抖动抽风

## 根因

`CompactHsvSlider` 把标签列与数值列写死为 `14.dp` / `32.dp`。超大系统字体下, `100%` / `360°` / `255` 等文本超出预留宽度, 被 Compose 判定放不下而换行

## 改动

- 标签/数值列由固定宽度改为 `widthIn(min = 实测文本宽)`, 宽度随系统字体缩放自适应; 预留不足时文字可自然变宽, 不再被截断或换行
- 标签与数值文本补 `maxLines = 1` + `softWrap = false` 兜底, 与既有 `ToolFloatSlider` 范式保持一致

## 验证

- `./gradlew :app:compileDebugKotlin` 通过
- `./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest` 通过
- 真机超大字体回归待确认

## 影响面

仅改动 `CompactHsvSlider`, 被色轮/方块/色彩和谐/滑杆页共用, 无签名变更

title: fix(liquify): 修复透明画布液化性能与残影问题并对齐七模式交互与 GPU 实时预览
body:
## 概述

本 PR 围绕**液化（Liquify）工具**在透明画布下的性能、残影与预览一致性问题，重构液化场的采样、物化与呈现链路，并将 GLES / 原生物化 / 录制 CPU 回放三条路径的场分辨率与预览基座推进策略统一为可单测的纯逻辑。分支已合并上游 `1.4.0` 并重建 `arm64-v8a` 原生库

### 改动类型

- **修复**：透明背景液化性能、透明画布残影、目标投影误写、Alpha8 插值、软选区回写、GPU 失败回退、无输入事务污染
- **优化**：GPU 实时预览、预览基座推进、稀疏场精度与大画布表现
- **测试**：新增 JVM 纯逻辑单测与原生针对性测试
- **文档**：移除过时液化实验 / 计划文档

## 主要改动

**1. 透明画布液化性能与残影**

- [`ReverieCoreMiscTools.cpp`](app/src/main/cpp/ReverieCoreMiscTools.cpp) 重构液化物化与像素采样主流程
- 新增 [`PixelAlpha.h`](app/src/main/cpp/PixelAlpha.h) 统一 alpha 预乘与插值处理，消除泛光 / 白边
- 新增 [`LiquifyPixelSampling.h`](app/src/main/cpp/LiquifyPixelSampling.h)、[`PixelRegion.h`](app/src/main/cpp/PixelRegion.h) 收敛采样与区域计算
- 新增 [`LiquifyMaterializeBatch.h`](app/src/main/cpp/LiquifyMaterializeBatch.h:7)，仅合并相邻水平 tile（不跨行、不含空隙），降低合成开销
- [`ReverieCoreRender.cpp`](app/src/main/cpp/ReverieCoreRender.cpp)、[`reverie_jni_tools.cpp`](app/src/main/cpp/reverie_jni_tools.cpp) 补充渲染与 JNI 支撑

**2. GPU 实时预览与基座推进策略**

- [`LiquifyGlesPreview.kt`](app/src/main/java/com/reverie/paint/core/LiquifyGlesPreview.kt) 覆盖层每帧上报真实绘制的文档矩形
- 新增 [`LiquifyPreviewBasePolicy.kt`](app/src/main/java/com/reverie/paint/model/LiquifyPreviewBasePolicy.kt:44)，保证基座**永不领先覆盖层**，并以笔刷影响半径为推进门槛，消除拖拽期间背景色线框闪烁
- [`LiquifyGlesOverlay.kt`](app/src/main/java/com/reverie/paint/ui/painting/canvas/LiquifyGlesOverlay.kt) 以单层实时预览替换旧呈现，修复透明画布液化残影

**3. 场分辨率三条路径统一**

- 新增 [`LiquifyFieldResolution.kt`](app/src/main/java/com/reverie/paint/model/LiquifyFieldResolution.kt:8)，统一 GLES / 原生物化 / 录制 CPU 回放的节点间距（≤ 2M 像素上限）
- 新增 [`LiquifyHalfFloat.kt`](app/src/main/java/com/reverie/paint/model/LiquifyHalfFloat.kt)、[`LiquifyFrameRects.kt`](app/src/main/java/com/reverie/paint/model/LiquifyFrameRects.kt) 支撑半精度移位与帧矩形滑动

**4. 七模式交互对齐与提交一致性**

- 新增 [`LiquifyProfessional.kt`](app/src/main/java/com/reverie/paint/model/LiquifyProfessional.kt:7)，统一笔刷直径 / 影响范围与基于位移、时间的强度增益（含左右推移模式 5 / 6）
- 新增 [`LiquifyCommitFence.kt`](app/src/main/java/com/reverie/paint/model/LiquifyCommitFence.kt)、[`LiquifyPresentationFence.kt`](app/src/main/java/com/reverie/paint/model/LiquifyPresentationFence.kt)，确保预览提交与呈现一致
- 对齐七模式交互并修复目标投影误写与无输入事务污染，GPU 失败时回退；补齐硬度、静止按住与大画布稀疏场精度；保持旧录制算法兼容

**5. UI 手势与面板**

- [`CanvasTouchView.kt`](app/src/main/java/com/reverie/paint/ui/painting/canvas/CanvasTouchView.kt) 液化手势分流与静止按住处理
- [`LiquifyPanel.kt`](app/src/main/java/com/reverie/paint/ui/painting/panels/LiquifyPanel.kt) 面板参数联动

### 测试与验证

- 新增 JVM 单测：[`LiquifyFieldResolutionTest.kt`](app/src/test/java/com/reverie/paint/model/LiquifyFieldResolutionTest.kt)、[`LiquifyFrameRectsTest.kt`](app/src/test/java/com/reverie/paint/model/LiquifyFrameRectsTest.kt)、[`LiquifyHalfFloatTest.kt`](app/src/test/java/com/reverie/paint/model/LiquifyHalfFloatTest.kt)、[`LiquifyProfessionalTest.kt`](app/src/test/java/com/reverie/paint/model/LiquifyProfessionalTest.kt)
- 新增原生测试：`tests/native/liquify_{dab_shortcut,kernel_shortcut,pixel_sampling,preview_region,professional,sampling_cache,scene}_test.cpp`
- 新增脚本：`scripts/test_liquify_audit.sh`、`scripts/test_liquify_kernel.py`、`scripts/test_liquify_live_preview.sh`
- 验证结果：`compileDebugKotlin` 通过、434 项 JVM 测试通过、液化原生 / GLES 回归通过、`arm64` Release 原生库与 beta APK 构建通过

### 已知遗留

- 全仓库 `lintDebug` 仍有 123 项既有错误，非本 PR 引入
- 无连接真机，实际设备回归未完成

### 兼容性

- 录制事件格式保持向后兼容（[`RecordingEvents.kt`](app/src/main/java/com/reverie/paint/model/RecordingEvents.kt) 仅新增字段）
- 重建 `third_party/android-native-libs/libreverie_jni.so` 并同步上游 1.4.0

> [!NOTE]
> 啊，真的没有思路了，按照CSP的公开文档的标准改吧... qwq
>
> 不知道这次能不能达到一个没有BUG的令人满意的标准 Orz

title: fix(replay): 修复旧录制填色及不透明度兼容
body:
## 变更概述

将 #52 收窄为旧录制填色事件的兼容修复，接入主线 `1fce2a44`。

主线 `c59c1cc` 已增加 `setFillLayerColor`：填充图层换色界面和携带颜色参数的新录制均走专用接口，原 PR 的主要界面场景已由主线处理。本次保留该接口及新事件行为，撤掉没有界面调用方的 `fillLayerForeground` 录制上下文补丁。

剩余实际入口是旧 `.revp` 中无颜色参数的 `L_FILL_LAYER`。主线仍通过 `fillLayer` 回放它，而 `paintRect` 没有配置填充样式或笔刷，回放不写入像素。本次改用 `fillSelection`，不透明度只应用一次，保留选区、透明度锁定和撤销事务。

旧文件漏记的上下文无法恢复，不宣称补全已丢失的颜色。Kotlin、JNI 签名和录制格式与主线一致。

## 变更类型

- [x] `fix`: 缺陷修复

## 架构自检

title: fix(layers): 修复调整层撤销、编辑状态恢复与特殊图层识别
body:
## 变更概述

修复特殊图层编辑时遇到的几处问题：调整层实时预览后点确认可能没有撤销记录；曲线、渐变再次打开时丢失控制点和色标；普通图层名字里带“滤镜 / Filter”“填充 / Fill”或“描边 / Stroke”时被误判为特殊图层。

- 调整层确认时与进入面板前的配置比较，预览过也能正常撤销；改回原值不增加空撤销。
- 在原有 LUT 后附加曲线主通道、RGB 控制点及渐变色标、透明度、反向状态。HUD、旧面板和新建入口共用转换逻辑，保存、再次编辑时可恢复这些信息。
- 图层类型改用引擎节点和显式属性判断。预填色图层的类型标记随复制、组内复制及工程保存保留，栅格化后按普通图层处理。
- 同步重新编译的 ARM64 `libreverie_jni.so`，补充 14 项单元测试和回归说明。

兼容处理：旧作品只有合成 LUT，无法唯一还原原始控制点，因此按采样重建编辑状态；未修改直接确认时保留原字节，避免画面变化。旧填充层如果只有名称、没有类型标记，会作为普通颜料层打开，原有像素保留。

title: fix(canvas): 双指旋转实时锁定标准角度并平滑释放
body:
双指旋转进入吸附范围时，画布立即锁定到最近的 90° 倍数，手指保持接触时也能看到精确对齐的预览。原先采用连续磁性曲线，范围内仍会小幅旋转，松手后才收敛到标准角度，与 issue 中期望的实时锁定不一致。

Fixes #26

## 改动

- 保留 0.6° 净转角的旋转意图判定，往返小抖动不会累计激活吸附
- 进入配置范围即锁定，退出使用 1.15 倍范围；默认捕获 5°、释放 5.75°
- 释放时仅应用越过退出边界的角度，从锁定角继续旋转，避免一次性补跳锁定期间积累的转角
- 释放后暂时禁止重新捕获同一目标，离开捕获范围或反向穿过目标后可再次吸附
- 中途停顿超过 150ms 时保留吸附状态；松手归位仅处理仍锁定的手势，避免把刚释放的角度拉回
- 触觉反馈依据实际锁定状态触发，旋转中心补偿继续使用实际显示角度增量

进入吸附区时允许向标准角度对齐；退出采用连续衔接。未修改原生引擎、撤销阈值或三指菜单。

## 验证

基于上游 `afbeea7b`：

- `:app:compileDebugKotlin`、`:app:testDebugUnitTest`、`:app:assembleDebug` 全部通过
- 433 项 JVM 测试，0 失败、0 错误、0 跳过
- 其中 14 项吸附状态机测试覆盖双向捕获、负角度和跨 0°、锁定时抖动/暂停、退出连续性、重新捕获、下一标准角、净转角防误触、设置变化与异常输入
- `git diff --check` 通过
- 测试者对提供的测试 APK 与测试流程反馈“测试完毕 ok”；未采集 ADB 日志或录屏，设备型号及逐项结果未单独记录

原先要求连续磁性映射的测试已改为实时锁定的行为契约测试，净转角防误触覆盖保留。操作步骤与验证范围见 `docs/ROTATION-SNAP-LOCK.md`。

title: fix(brush): 支持 ABR v7~v10、修正导入笔刷尺寸与 .kpp 文本块布局
body:
## 背景

v1.3.9 的 `6901e396` 已经把 ABR 的 OOM（边解码边落盘 + 150px 缩略图）、重启笔尖丢失（`requiredBrushFilesList` + C++ 侧判定）与「导入后误变橡皮擦」修掉了。这个 PR **不重复那三项**，只带上游还没覆盖的部分 —— 其中第一条决定了其余针对 ABR 的修复对这个合集是否有效。

---

## 一、v7~v10 合集一款都导不进来

`AbrParser.parse()` 的版本分发是 `when (version) { 1,2; 6; else -> 空 }`，而 Photoshop CS6 之后导出的合集基本都是 v7~v10。

实测 375 款合集的文件头是 `00 0a 00 02`（version 10），直接落进 `else` 返回空结果 —— **一款都进不来**。

v6 之后的版本号只代表 Photoshop 加了新特性，`8BIM` 分节骨架（`samp` / `desc`）没有变化。逐字节核对 subversion=2 的 301 字节头偏移在 v10 下依然成立：

```
top/left/bottom/right = 262/311/672/721    depth=8    compression=1    410x410
```

因此把判断放宽为区间 `6..MAX_SUPPORTED_VERSION` 即可，解析逻辑本身不需要改。顺带让 `parseVersion6` 读回真实 version 而不是硬编码 `6`，返回的 `version` 字段不再骗人。

---

## 二、导入笔刷的尺寸被报成笔尖原始像素

Krita `libs/brush/kis_scaling_size_brush.cpp`：

```cpp
qreal KisScalingSizeBrush::userEffectiveSize() const
{ return qMax(this->width(), this->height()) * this->scale(); }
```

`KisBrushBasedPaintOpSettings::paintOpSize()` 返回的就是它 —— **preset XML 里的 `paintopSize` 键对文件型笔尖完全无效**，`brush_definition` 的 `scale` 才是唯一来源。

原代码把 `scale` 写死 `1`，等于把笔尖原始像素当成笔刷尺寸。实测：

| 笔尖 | ABR 声明 diameter | 引擎实际报出 |
|---|---|---|
| 282 × 282 | 80 | **282** |
| 99 × 176 | 120 | **176** |

改为导入时写入 `scale = diameter / max(宽,高)`，引擎读数与 ABR 声明一致。

- `tipScale` 传 `null` 时沿用文件里已有的 `scale`，不写回 1。否则笔刷工坊每改一次参数，导入笔刷的尺寸就被打回笔尖原始像素。
- 新增 `resolvePresetSize`：引擎回报 `1.0` 时改用该预设记录的尺寸。`1.0` 是 `paintOpSize()` 里 `KIS_SAFE_ASSERT_RECOVER_RETURN_VALUE(this->brush(), 1.0)` 的哨兵值；而 `KisBrush::fromXML` 的兜底 `auto_brush` 缺 `<MaskGenerator>`，其 diameter 默认值恰好也是 1.0（`KisAutoBrushFactory` 的 `attr("diameter", "1.0")`）。两条路都把「笔刷未解析」谎报成 1px，且 1.0 能让 `size > 0` 的兜底判断通过，UI 就停在最小值。

判据收得很紧：只在引擎值 `<= 1.0` **且**记忆中确有 `> 1.0` 的尺寸时才替换。用户自己把尺寸调成 1px 的情况不会被覆盖，内置预设（无记忆值）行为完全不变。

---

## 三、计算型预设会绑上别人的采样笔尖

`desc` 段里计算型笔刷没有 `sampledData`，`tipUuid` 为 null；但 `tipIndex` 被填成「下标 + 1」，而配对表达式无条件走

```kotlin
tipsByUuid[uuid] ?: tipsByIndex[preset.tipIndex] ?: tips.first()
```

于是每一支计算型预设都会绑到一支不属于它的采样笔尖。实测 375 笔尖 / 493 预设的合集里有 **47 支** 中招。

后果不只是缩略图画错：落盘 `.kpp` 的 `brush_definition` 会变成指向别人笔尖的 `png_brush`，实际笔触完全走样。

抽出 `matchTipForPreset`，对 `tipUuid == null` 直接返回 null，让调用方退化成 `auto_brush` 圆笔尖。修复后 47 → 0。

---

## 四、`.kpp` 文本块布局：preset 块落在所有 IDAT 之后

Krita 的 `KisPaintOpPreset::loadFromDevice` 在 `reader.read()` **之前** 调 `text("version")` / `text("preset")`，而 Qt 的 `QPngHandler` 在那个时点只暴露 pre-IDAT 的文本块 —— **写在 IDAT 之后等于没写**。

`replacePresetXml` 原本在 `IEND` 前插入，于是「用程序生成的 PNG 当底图」这条路径（ABR 导入走的正是它，底图来自 `encodePreviewPng`）产出的 `.kpp` 块序是错的：

```
IHDR → IDAT → zTXt(preset) → IEND                      ← 现在的行为
IHDR → zTXt(preset) → tEXt(version) → IDAT → IEND      ← 期望
```

表现：**导入当次正常**（参数直接作用于内存里的 preset），**重启后**引擎从 `.kpp` 读不到 preset，回退 `auto_brush`，所有导入笔刷变成一模一样的圆球。

改为「摘掉原有的 preset/version 块，统一在第一个 IDAT 之前写回」，并补上底图缺失的 `version` 块（沿用底图已有值，实测 Krita 5.x 写出的是 `2.2`）。

---

## 五、加固

**笔尖尺寸判据**：原判断只挡单边 16384 上限，而 `decodePackBitsScanlines` 的第一行就是 `ByteArray(height * width)` —— 声明 16384×16384 的损坏笔尖会先申请 **268MB**，且是 `OutOfMemoryError`（`Error` 而非 `Exception`），调用方的 try/catch 全都兜不住。改为单边 8192 + 总像素 64M（该合集里最大的笔尖是 3480×3426 ≈ 11.9M 像素，留 5 倍以上余量）。

**chunk 长度改用 Long 累加判越界**：`length` 来自文件，损坏时可以是 `0x7FFFFFFF`。用 Int 累加会溢出成负数使 `> size` 判断失效，随后 `idx` 变成负偏移，下一轮 `ByteBuffer.wrap` 或 `out.write` 直接抛 `IndexOutOfBoundsException`。这条路径对用户从网上下载的合集是可达的。

---

## 验证

新增 19 条用例，全量 **53 套件 / 417 用例 / 0 失败 0 错误 0 跳过**。

做了反向验证（把修复逐条改回旧实现，确认测试确实会红）：

| 回退的修复 | 变红的用例 |
|---|---|
| 版本分发改回 `6 ->` | `v7 to v10 packs parse into tips...` |
| `matchTipForPreset` 恢复无条件兜底 | `a computed preset never binds a sampled tip` |
| 块序改回 IEND 前插入 | `preset / version 文本块必须排在第一个 IDAT 之前`、`用真实 kpp 作底图时...` |

反向验证还发现原先有一条用例是**假绿** —— 它只断言 `result.version`，而旧代码对非 v6 也会把版本号原样回显。已补上笔尖条数与 subversion 断言。

改动全在 Kotlin 侧（`app/src/main/java` 与单元测试），不涉及原生代码。

---

## 一点说明

第四节、第五节提到的都不是新引入的回归，而是 `6901e396` 在同一个方向上没扫到的角落。如果其中某一项你已经用别的方式解决了，告诉我，我把对应部分摘掉，只留剩下的。

title: fix(import): 同尺寸图片保持原大小并对齐画布
body:
导入宽高与画布完全一致的图片时，保留原始尺寸并放在画布原点，便于准确叠加。

例如将 1000×1000 图片导入 1000×1000 画布：原来会缩小为 800×800、放在 `(100, 100)`；现在保持 1000×1000、放在 `(0, 0)`，导入流程也会跳过位图缩放。

Fixes #12

## 改动

- 在尺寸计算中为宽高均与画布一致的图片跳过 80% 缩放限制
- 仍按现有流程导入为新图层；其他尺寸图片继续按原规则等比缩放和居中
- 新增 5 项测试，覆盖正方形、横竖图、奇数尺寸、默认参数、仅一边相同、仅比例相同以及无效尺寸

## 验证

- 先在原实现运行新增测试，11 项导入测试中 2 项同尺寸对齐测试失败，确认能检出问题
- 修复后 `:app:compileDebugKotlin`、`:app:testDebugUnitTest`、`:app:assembleDebug` 全部通过；393 项测试，0 失败（包含新增 5 项）
- `git diff --check` 通过

尚未真机验证。建议新建 1000×1000 画布，导入同尺寸且四角有标记的 PNG，检查四边完全贴齐、无需手动放大；再导入其他尺寸图片确认原有缩放和居中行为。

title: fix(project): 保存失败时保留编辑状态和恢复草稿
body:
底层保存返回失败或抛异常时，原来的 `saveProject()` 仍会清除未保存状态并调用完成回调，导致“保存并退出”提示成功后返回画廊。如果目标位置已有旧文件，还会将其存在且非空误判为本次保存成功，清理恢复草稿并触发备份。

现在只有本次保存返回成功、目标确实为非空文件时才提交保存状态；失败时提示重试，保留文档状态和草稿，不执行成功或退出回调。

## 改动

- 保存结果从引擎任务传到完成回调，异常时默认按失败处理
- `currentProjectFile` 延后到保存成功才更新，另存失败不改变原路径和名称
- 失败时保留 `isModified`、已保存笔画计数与恢复草稿，不触发自动备份

title: fix(replay,animation,stylus): 离页与后台停止常驻媒体与渲染活动, 修复回放播完后耗电异常
body: 问题复现： - 使用设备：三星 Galaxy Tab S10+ - 打开软件，新建画布，进行绘画 - 在主界面回放画作，回放完毕后退回主界面 - 将软件留在后台2~5分钟 - 设备提示软件以静音播放视频的形式异常高耗电 根因: - 动画播放步进链 animationStep 挂在 reverie-render 线程上自续且默认循环, goHome/goCreate/goReplay 均未停播; 返回主页或进入回放后仍按帧率做全量投影 渲染, 导入音频的 MediaPlayer 也持续循环播放, 系统据此判定"应用在静音播放 视频"。回放自身的步进链已停止而该链仍在运行, 故表现为回放播完后耗电不下。 - 纸张音效引擎的"管线预热"在启用后无条件持续写静音 PCM, 切后台也不停止, 常驻 USAGE_MEDIA 输出被系统计入媒体播放耗电。 - 画布卸载未停喷枪自续链与在途笔画样本; 切后台后绘画计时协程仍每秒唤醒。 修复: - 新增 stopAnimationPlaybackForPageExit() 并在 goHome/goCreate/goReplay 调用; animationStep 增加"非绘画页即自停"兜底。 - PaperSoundEngine 增加场景门控 setActive(): 仅绘画页且 Activity STARTED 时保持 预热, 其余场景挂起 worker 并 pause AudioTrack; 门控由 MainActivity 的 onStart/onStop 与页面切换驱动, 刻意不用 onPause 以保留分屏失焦时的绘画音效。 - CanvasTouchView.onDetachedFromWindow 停止喷枪/起笔 kick/未投递样本与摩擦音效。 - onAppBackgrounded 停止每秒计时协程, 新增 onAppForegrounded 回前台恢复。 验证: compileDebugKotlin / testDebugUnitTest / assembleDebug / assembleRelease -PappIdSuffix=.beta 全部通过; 三星 Tab S10+ 实机回归 (绘画页循环播放动画 -> 返回主页 -> 进入回放 -> 播完后停留观察), 系统不再出现"以静音方式播放视频"的高耗电预警。

title: fix(liquify): 液化沿路径补点, 修复快速拖动时笔迹断线 (#3)
body:
修 #3 里的第 2 条「液化工具出现断线：使用液化推拉绘制的时候，线条会出断线、断口」。

## 根因

两个因素叠加：

1. **液化的移动分支不消费历史点。** `CanvasTouchView` 里 BRUSH/ERASER/SMUDGE 分支会遍历 `event.historySize` 把 coalesced points 全部喂给引擎，而 `Tool.LIQUIFY` 分支只取当帧最终点调用一次 `liquify(prev → cur)`。触摸采样率高于渲染帧率时，一帧内的中间采样点被整批丢弃。

2. **单次液化的形变只在起点邻域按高斯衰减铺开**，影响半径由笔刷尺寸决定（引擎侧 `sigma = max(8, liquifyBrushSize)`）。所以当一次事件的位移明显大于笔刷尺寸时，相邻两次形变的影响范围搭接不上，中间留下未被形变的空档。

表现就是断口，且手越快、笔刷越小越明显——与 #3 的描述一致。

## 改动

- 历史点与当帧点一并消费；
- 每段位移按笔刷尺寸的 `0.3` 倍间距细分补点（上限 12 个，约束单帧内跨 JNI 的调用次数），让相邻形变充分搭接；
- 纯几何部分抽到 `model/LiquifyPath`，按 AGENTS.md 的约定配了单测。

## 强度折算（这块想请你过一眼）

细分之后必须保证总形变量和细分前一致，否则修完断线会变成"形变过头"。两类模式不一样：

- **推拉（mode 0）**：引擎侧位移是 `(tx-fx) * s`，不经过幅度曲线。各补点的 delta 之和等于原位移，总量天然守恒，强度原样传。
- **膨胀/收缩/顺时针/逆时针（mode 1-4）**：引擎侧幅度是 `0.2 + 0.8 * min(1, dist/size)`，其中 `0.2` 的固定底会随补点数累加。比如 120px 位移、60px 笔刷拆成 7 段，不折算就会变成原来的约 3 倍形变。所以按「整段等效幅度 / 各补点幅度之和」折算强度。

单测里用引擎同款曲线校核了折算前后总量一致（`radial modes keep the total deformation unchanged after subdivision`）。

一个已知边界：折算后的强度可能低于引擎的 `qBound(0.05, s, 2.0)` 下限，此时会被夹住、形变略微偏弱。只在原强度本身就很低（小于约 0.25）且位移很长时才会触发，我没有为此额外补偿，因为那会让代码复杂度超过收益——如果你觉得该处理，我可以加。

## 验证

- `./gradlew :app:compileDebugKotlin` 通过
- `./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest` 通过（含新增 9 个用例）
- 基线 v1.3.0 `8093fcb`

没有在真机上量化过手感：间距 `0.3` 与上限 `12` 是按"影响半径充分搭接"和"限制单帧 JNI 次数"估的，你在真机上觉得偏密或偏疏，改 `LiquifyPath` 里两个常量即可。

## 与已提 PR 的关系

和 #5 不冲突，改的是不同文件：这条是采样路径（Kotlin），#5 是引擎侧回写（C++，修的是边缘锯齿，跟断线是两个缺陷）。两者可以独立合入。

title: Fix the demo chat never connecting for built-in users
body:
### Goal

Fixes [AND-1580](https://linear.app/stream/issue/AND-1580/demo-app-chat-never-connects-for-built-in-users)

In the demo app, the call chat never loaded for a user from the built-in users list. The chat client connected as `user.id` but requested its token for `user.custom["email"]`. Built-in users have no email, so the token was for another user and the connection failed.

### Implementation

- The chat `TokenProvider` in `StreamVideoInitHelper.initializeStreamChat` requests the token for the connected user id.
- The video `TokenProvider` in `initializeStreamVideo` also uses `user.id` directly. The email fallback it replaced always gave the same id, because only `LoginViewModel.signInSuccess` sets `email`, and it sets it to the same value as `id`.
- Removed the unused `token` parameter of `initializeStreamChat`.

### Testing

1. Install a development debug build of the demo app.
2. Log in with a built-in user (for example `andrerego`).
3. Start a new call and join it.
4. Open the chat: the channel loads, and a sent message shows as sent.

Also check that a Google or email login still connects chat and video.

Validation: `./gradlew spotlessApply` and `:demo-app:compileDevelopmentDebugKotlin` pass. Steps 1 to 4 were run on an API 35 emulator. The logcat shows the chat token request with `user_id` and no JWT mismatch error. The video provider only runs on token renewal, and that path was not triggered on device.

title: Fix broadcast receiver leak in call service
body:
### Goal

Closes #AND-1532

Prevent `CallService` from leaking its dynamically registered `ToggleCameraBroadcastReceiver` when the service is destroyed.

The receiver must never remain registered after the service lifecycle ends, regardless of which shutdown path destroyed the service.

### How the leak happens

The receiver is registered when `CallService` initializes:

```text
Incoming call starts CallService
→ initializeService()
→ registerToggleCameraBroadcastReceiver()
```

When the incoming call is rejected externally:

```text
ExternalCallRejectionHandler
→ ServiceLauncher.removeIncomingCall()
→ CallService receives TRIGGER_REMOVE_INCOMING_CALL
→ stopServiceGracefully()
→ internalStopServiceGracefully()
→ receiver is unregistered
→ stopSelf()
```

However, the remove-call handling currently returns `START`. This causes `handleCallIntent()` to call `initializeService()` again before Android destroys the service:

```text
receiver unregistered
→ stopSelf()
→ initializeService()
→ receiver registered again
→ Android calls onDestroy()
```

Previously, `onDestroy()` did not unregister the newly registered receiver. The application context therefore retained a receiver associated with the destroyed service, resulting in a leaked `IntentReceiver`.

This PR only fixes the receiver leak. 
The broader service reinitialization and multi-call ownership behavior will be handled separately.

### Implementation

Added receiver cleanup to `CallService.onDestroy()`:

```kotlin
serviceStateController.unregisterToggleCameraBroadcastReceiver(this)
```

This makes `onDestroy()` the final lifecycle cleanup boundary. Cleanup remains safe when the receiver was already unregistered because `ServiceStateController` treats repeated unregistration as a no-op.

### 🎨 UI Changes

None

### Testing

1. Reject an incoming call from notification
2. No leak should be present in the log-cat

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

## Summary by CodeRabbit

- **Bug Fixes**
  - Improved call service cleanup by ensuring the toggle-camera broadcast receiver is unregistered when the service is destroyed.

- **Tests**
  - Added coverage verifying that receiver registration state and references are cleared during service cleanup.
