title: fix(extension): prepare Chrome Web Store package and localized assets
body:
Chrome Web Store rejects the existing Chromium ZIP because its manifest contains the development `key`. Generate a separate `ketch-extension-<version>-chrome-store.zip` without that field, while preserving the stable ID in the local-install package. Release CI includes the new artifact automatically.

Prepare the store assets under `art/browser-extension`: extension icons and 1280 × 800 English and Simplified Chinese screenshots rendered from the actual popup with fixed sample data. Include a repeatable rendering script and align the Page resources button with the popup's other controls.

Document the store upload package, asset regeneration, and the need to register the assigned store ID for desktop native launching.

Validation:
- All 159 browser extension tests pass, including ZIP manifest and release-version checks.
- Built version 0.2.3 and verified the store ZIP's version, absence of `key`, and inclusion of the button fix.
- Rendered and visually reviewed both screenshots; the renderer checks JavaScript errors and popup overflow.
- `git diff --check` passes.

title: Fix download right-click menus and add empty-space actions
body:
Right-clicking a download now opens its task menu at the pointer in both table and list views. Right-clicking empty space opens the same global actions as the top-right ⋯ button, including on an empty downloads page.

The row handler previously used Compose’s primary-button-only `awaitFirstDown`, so desktop right-clicks never reached the existing menu logic. The shared context-click handler also restores the table header’s column chooser, supports Mac Control-click, and keeps task clicks from opening the background menu. Existing multi-selection and touch behavior are preserved.

Validation: 43 targeted JVM tests passed, including rendered menu interactions in table/list views, selection and row-menu tests, and UI text/design-token guards. `:app:shared:compileKotlinWasmJs` passed. The new right-click regression tests failed before the fix.

title: fix(extension): keep the Download button and settings labels on one line
body:
## Problem

In Simplified Chinese, the popup's Download button wraps one character per line: 下 sits above 载 in a thin, tall pill, and the link field beside it stretches to match. The add row is a flex row, and the button is allowed to shrink. CJK text can break between any two characters, so the button shrinks until it is one character wide. Latin labels like "Herunterladen" or "Télécharger" have no break inside the word, so they never shrank.

I rendered the popup and the options page in all ten locales and found the same problem in more places:

| Where | Locales affected |
|---|---|
| Popup Download button (下/载, ダウンロ/ード, 다운로/드) | zh_CN, zh_TW, ja, ko |
| Options "File types" label, squeezed beside its full-width select ("File / types", "文件类/型") | every locale, English included |
| Options Diagnostics buttons, wrapping their labels on one cramped row | fr and ru at full width; every locale at 480px |
| Options instance card actions (Test connection, Remove) | ru at phone width (360px, e.g. Firefox for Android) |

## Changes

- `popup.css`: `.add > button { flex: none; white-space: nowrap; }` keeps the button at its natural width.
- `options.css`: `.row > select { flex: 1; }` makes the select take the space the label leaves, instead of starting at 100% and squeezing the label.
- `options.css`: `.add-buttons` and `.instance-actions` get `flex-wrap: wrap`, so a row that is too narrow moves whole buttons to the next line instead of wrapping their labels.

## Verification

- `node --test` in `app/browser-extension`: 158 passed, 0 failed.
- I rendered the popup (connected, app not running and capture paused) and the options page (at 1000, 640, 480 and 360px) in every locale with headless Chrome and stubbed extension APIs. I then checked every text line, button and input:
  - **Before:** the problems in the table above.
  - **After:** no button, select or input wraps, stretches or clips, and nothing scrolls sideways. The only remaining wraps are bold or code phrases breaking at the end of a line inside help paragraphs, which is normal text flow.
- I compared element geometry with the new rules on and off:
  - **Popup:** identical in en, de, es, fr, pt_BR and ru in every state. It only changes in zh_CN, zh_TW, ja and ko.
  - **Options page:** in English, the only change is the File types row, which is 8px shorter now that its label fits on one line. The content below it moves up by the same amount.

title: Fix opening downloaded executables on Windows
body:
Opening a downloaded Windows installer fails with `Unsupported URI content`: Java's desktop API rejects executable file types even when it reports support for `OPEN`.

Route Windows file opening through Explorer, passing the absolute path as one explicitly quoted argument so Explorer preserves commas even in paths without whitespace. No command shell interprets the filename. Keep the existing macOS and Linux launch behavior. Add regression coverage for installers, documents, folders, special characters, comma-only paths, and platform routing.

Validation: `./gradlew :app:shared:jvmTest --tests '*FileActionsJvmTest'` passed all 15 tests from the isolated PR worktree on macOS, without excluding any test sources. Actual file launching and installer elevation still need a Windows smoke test.

title: fix(discover): remind the agent to answer when it only narrates
body:
## Problem

A Discover search with an OpenAI-compatible endpoint running `glm-5.3` found nothing. The log shows the agent searching and fetching normally for about 50 seconds. Then the model sent a progress note with no tool call ("The archive.org search API works. Now let me check Wikimedia Commons…"). Koog's default `singleRunStrategy` ends the run on any reply without a tool call, so that note became the final output. `AgentOutputParser` found no JSON in it (`No JSON answer in agent output; taking it as text`), and the search returned 0 candidates with the note as its summary.

## Change

- `ResourceDiscoveryService.discoveryStrategy`: the same loop as Koog's single run, with one change. A reply that holds neither tool calls nor a JSON answer gets a reminder ("call the next tool now, or return only the JSON object described in OUTPUT"), up to `MAX_ANSWER_REMINDERS` (2) times a run. After that the reply ends the run as before. Edges resolve in the order they are declared, so tool calls are checked first, then a reply that ends the run, then the reminder.
- `AgentOutputParser.hasAnswer()` tells whether a reply holds a JSON answer the parser reads. An answer with no candidates counts, so it ends the run without a reminder.
- `agentIterations` adds one iteration per possible reminder, so a reminded run does not hit the step limit sooner.
- AGENTS.md notes the behavior.

## Tests

`./gradlew :ai:discover:test` passes. New cases in `ResourceDiscoveryServiceTest`:
- a reply that only narrates gets the reminder, and the run then returns the agent's candidates
- a model that never answers stops after the reminders, with its text as the summary
- a JSON answer with no candidates ends the run without a reminder

Not run against a live GLM endpoint yet.

title: fix(desktop): show Chinese text in the Windows tray menu
body:
## What

On Windows builds, the `createRuntimeImage` (jlink) task now writes `runtime/conf/fonts/fontconfig.properties`. It contains the runtime's own `lib/fontconfig.properties.src` template plus these sequences:

```
sequence.allfonts.UTF-8.zh.CN=alphabetic,chinese-ms936,dingbats,symbol,chinese-ms936-extb
sequence.allfonts.UTF-8.zh.SG=(same as zh.CN)
sequence.allfonts.UTF-8.zh.TW=alphabetic,chinese-ms950,dingbats,symbol,chinese-ms950-extb
sequence.allfonts.UTF-8.zh.HK=alphabetic,chinese-ms950,chinese-hkscs,dingbats,symbol,chinese-ms950-extb
sequence.allfonts.UTF-8.zh.MO=(same as zh.HK)
sequence.allfonts.UTF-8=alphabetic/default,chinese-ms936,japanese,korean,dingbats,symbol
```

## Why

On Chinese Windows, every Chinese item in the tray menu showed as a row of boxes. Only the Latin text ("Ketch", "110 GB") rendered.

- Compose's `Tray` menu is a native AWT `PopupMenu`. Windows AWT owner-draws its items with the component fonts of the logical "Dialog" font, chosen by `FontConfiguration` from the JVM's default charset and startup locale.
- Since JDK 18 (JEP 400) the default charset is UTF-8. JDK 21's Windows fontconfig, and JDK mainline's, defines UTF-8 sequences only for `UTF-8.hi`, `UTF-8.ja` and `UTF-8.ko`. So `zh` falls back to `sequence.allfonts=alphabetic/default,dingbats,symbol`.
- `alphabetic/default` uses `WDefaultFontCharset`, which only accepts characters in Arial's character map. No component can draw Han characters, so they become boxes.
- The new sequences use the same fonts the JDK picks for the GBK, `x-windows-950` and `x-MS950-HKSCS` charsets (SimSun, MingLiU, MingLiU_HKSCS).
- The `UTF-8` catch-all adds CJK fallback for other locales, for someone running Windows in English with Ketch set to Chinese, Japanese or Korean. It only applies to characters that Arial can't draw.

AWT reads `<java.home>/conf/fonts/fontconfig.properties` before `lib/fontconfig.bfc` (`FontConfiguration.findFontConfigFile`), so this needs no runtime code or JVM flags. The Compose UI draws with Skia and isn't affected. Only AWT text (the tray menu) changes.

## Verification

- The JDK build's own `CompileFontConfig` (`FontConfiguration.loadProperties` + `saveBinary`), run on the release runtime's template, reproduces the shipped `fontconfig.bfc` byte for byte. It compiles the patched file without errors, and the six new locale entries resolve to existing components.
- I ran the `doLast` locally with the Windows guard forced on: the file is written, and it works with the configuration cache.
- **Not yet seen on Windows.** Please check the tray menu on Chinese Windows with a build from this branch.

title: fix(release): mark the Windows ARM64 MSI as Arm64
body:
## What

Adds a release workflow step that, after jpackage builds the Windows ARM64 MSI, changes its summary information to target the `Arm64` platform (Windows Installer schema 500), then reads it back to confirm.

## Why

The ARM64 MSI fails to install with Windows Installer error 1723: *"There is a problem with this Windows Installer package. A DLL required for this install to complete could not be run."* The portable `.zip` works.

Inspecting the v0.0.3 release MSIs with msitools:

| | Template (platform) | `Binary.JpCaDll` (jpackage's `wixhelper.dll`) |
|---|---|---|
| `windows-x64.msi` | `x64;1033` | PE32+ x86-64 |
| `windows-arm64.msi` | `x64;1033` | PE32+ **Aarch64** |

jpackage (with the runners' WiX 3.11) always writes `x64` as the platform. Its `JpFindRelatedProducts` and `JpCheckInstallDir` custom actions call into `JpCaDll`. For an x64 package, Windows Installer runs that DLL in its x64 (emulated) custom action host, which can't load an ARM64 DLL, so every install fails. With the platform set to `Arm64`, the DLL runs in the native ARM64 host. WiX's own `WixCA` and `WixUIWixca` are 32-bit and still run in the x86 host.

The x64 MSI is unaffected: its DLL is x64 and imports only system libraries.

## Notes for reviewers

- **Not yet verified on Windows.** The step only runs on the `windows-11-arm` release job, and neither PowerShell nor Windows Installer is available on macOS. It throws if the MSI isn't `x64;…` before the edit or `Arm64;…` after it, so a failure breaks the release job instead of shipping a bad package.
- Schema 500 means Windows Installer 5.0, which every Windows on ARM version has.
- Until a release includes this, ARM64 users can install the x64 MSI, which runs under emulation, or use the portable ARM64 `.zip`.

title: fix(discover): stop telling the agent to filter when the content filter is off
body:
## Problem

With **Content filter** switched off, Discover still refused requests such as "3 hottest tv shows", with a *Filtering* step that cites an anti-piracy policy. The switch only skipped `DeviceSafetyFilter` on the parsed answer. The system prompt was the same either way: it always carried the **ANTI-PIRACY GUARDRAIL** and the `BLOCK …` device-safety rules, so the model refused before the filter was ever reached.

## Change

- `ResourceDiscoveryService.SYSTEM_PROMPT` is now `systemPrompt(contentFilter)`, and each run passes in `DiscoverQuery.contentFilter`.
- **Filter on:** the prompt says the same as before; only one line is rewrapped.
- **Filter off:** the anti-piracy guardrail is left out, and the `BLOCK …` rules become "rank riskier links lower and say why in `deviceSafetyNotes`", and the output rule says "If no candidates" instead of "If no safe candidates". The model still prefers official sources, and the rules about ignoring instructions in fetched pages and never downloading automatically stay.
- `docs/ai-discovery.md` and `AGENTS.md` describe the new behavior. The provider's model may still decline a request on its own.

## Testing

- Added two tests that check the system prompt the LLM receives has the guardrail and `BLOCK` rules with the filter on and has neither with it off.
- `./gradlew :ai:discover:test` passes.
- Not yet tried with a live search.

title: fix(discover): keep HTTPS installers from vendor sites and add clear selection
body:
## What

- **Safety filter** (`DeviceSafetyFilter`): installers (`.exe`, `.msi`, `.dmg`, `.pkg`, `.apk`) from hosts off the built-in trusted list are no longer hard-blocked. Over HTTPS they are kept with a 0.2 score penalty, so they rank below the same file from a listed host. Without HTTPS they are still blocked.
- New hard blocks for every file type: hosts that imitate a trusted domain from outside its site (`fake-github.com`, `github.com.example.net`) and http(s) URLs carrying user info (`github.com@evil.example`). Other hosts of a trusted domain's own site, such as `archive-downloads.apache.org`, are not treated as fakes.
- **Discover add bar**: an × button before "N selected" clears the whole selection, including results picked in earlier messages (`AiDiscoverController.clearSelection()`). It reuses the existing `discover_clear_selection` string.

## Why

The agent accepted three official PureWriter installers hosted on `kuromi.drakeet.cn`, but the filter dropped all three because that host isn't on the list. Most vendors host installers on their own domain, so the old rule hid nearly every official installer outside GitHub/SourceForge.

The selection bar could say "1 from earlier" with no quick way to drop a pick that was far up the chat.

## Notes for reviewers

- A switch to turn the filter off, and a note when it hides results, follow in a separate PR stacked on this one.

## Tests

- `DeviceSafetyFilterTest`: unlisted HTTPS installer kept and scored below a trusted one, unlisted HTTP installer blocked, look-alike hosts and user info blocked, sibling hosts of a trusted site kept.
- `AiDiscoverControllerTest`: `clearSelection()` deselects results across turns.

title: fix(desktop): add Start menu and desktop shortcuts to the Windows installer
body:
## What

Sets `menuGroup = "Ketch"` and `shortcut = true` in the desktop app's `nativeDistributions.windows` block.

## Why

After installing the MSI, Ketch couldn't be opened, while the portable `.zip` worked. The Compose Gradle plugin's `WindowsPlatformSettings` defaults `menu` and `shortcut` to `false`, so jpackage got neither `--win-menu` nor `--win-shortcut`. The MSI installed `Ketch.exe` under `C:\Program Files\Ketch\` with no Start menu entry and no desktop shortcut, so there was nothing to launch it from. The portable copy is launched straight from its folder, so it wasn't affected. Both are built from the same `createReleaseDistributable` output.

Setting `menuGroup` turns on `menu` (the plugin's getter is `field || menuGroup != null`) and names the Start menu folder, which jpackage otherwise calls "Unknown".

## Notes for reviewers

- Not verified on Windows: `packageReleaseMsi` only runs there. On macOS, `:app:desktop:help` configures without errors.
- The `upgradeUuid` doesn't change, so existing installs get the shortcuts on their next upgrade, including through the in-app updater's `msiexec`.
- The desktop shortcut is optional. jpackage can't let users opt out of it at install time, so drop `shortcut = true` if you'd rather only add the Start menu entry.
- If the installed app still doesn't start when `Ketch.exe` is run directly, that's a separate problem. It would show up in `%APPDATA%\ketch\logs\ketch.log`.

title: fix(desktop): open Settings About from macOS app menu
body:
The macOS “About Ketch” menu item opened the system About dialog, which could show a version different from the app's actual version. It now opens Settings → About and brings the existing Settings window forward when already open.

Registers and removes the native About handler alongside the Settings handler, checking support independently for each action.

Validation: `./gradlew :app:desktop:test --tests '*SettingsWindowStateTest' --tests '*DesktopCommandsTest' --console=plain` passed. The native menu click has not been manually verified.

title: fix(android): use Android DNS-SD registrar for local server
body:
Starting the local server with mDNS enabled crashed Android with `NoClassDefFoundError: NetService_jvmKt`: the JVM server registrar called a factory that is absent from the Android DNS-SD artifact.

Wire an Android-specific registrar into `KetchService`, compiled against the Android DNS-SD dependency. Retain the service before registration so failed or cancelled attempts can be cleaned up. Narrow the ProGuard suppression to the unused JVM factory and document the platform requirement for server callers.

Validation:
- All 12 `MdnsRegistrationTest` tests passed.
- Android debug and R8 release builds passed.
- Bytecode inspection confirmed the registrar calls `NetService_androidKt`; APK inspection confirmed that factory is packaged.
- Device runtime testing has not been performed.

title: fix(discover): trust official Blender downloads
body:
Discovery discarded every Blender macOS installer after the agent accepted it because `download.blender.org` was missing from the safety filter's trusted domains. Add the official download host so those candidates survive the final filter.

Regression tests cover the Blender installer through both the safety filter and output parser, and verify that lookalike hosts and URLs disguising the host as user info remain blocked.

Validation: `./gradlew :ai:discover:test` passed; `git diff --check` passed.

title: fix(server): require a token beyond loopback and confine client paths
body:
## Why

With the default configuration (no config file, or the `--generate-config` template, and no `--token`), `ketch server` bound `0.0.0.0:8642` without a token and advertised `token=none` over mDNS. Host validation and the cross-origin guard only stop browsers, so any client on the network (e.g. `curl`) could:

- `POST /api/tasks` with an absolute destination; file destinations were used as-is, with no deduplication, so existing files could be overwritten
- `POST /api/tasks/{id}/resume?destination=…` to point a paused or failed task at another file
- `DELETE /api/tasks/{id}?deleteFiles=true` to delete the file at a task's output path

## What changed

**Token by default (`ketch server`, `cli/.../ServerToken.kt`)**
- Listening beyond loopback always needs a token. The server uses the first of `--token`, `KETCH_API_TOKEN`, `apiToken` in the config, or an `api-token` file in the config directory.
- If that file is missing, the server creates it readable by the owner only (`rw-------`, created with its permissions) and prints the token on that first run. Looser permissions on an existing file are tightened.
- `config.toml` is never rewritten; it is shared with the desktop app and holds the user's comments.
- `--no-token` opts out and prints a warning. A loopback server takes no token unless one is given.
- With a token and no `corsAllowedHosts`, the CLI allows any origin, like the apps, so the hosted web app can connect.
- `KetchServer` now binds to `127.0.0.1` by default and logs a warning when it listens elsewhere without a token.

**Allowed folders (`DestinationPathPolicy` in core, `DestinationGuard` in server)**
- Covers new tasks' destinations, resume destinations, `PUT /api/config`'s `defaultDirectory`, and `deleteFiles=true`.
- Allowed folders: the download directory plus the new `ServerConfig.allowedDirectories` (`--allowed-dirs`).
- Relative paths are placed in the download directory and `..` is resolved. Symlinks are followed, so a link pointing outside counts as outside; links to missing targets are refused.
- Names go through main's `sanitizeFileName()`.
- A file path that exists, or that a running download holds in `OutputPathReservations`, gets a free name such as `file (1).zip` instead. This uses the new non-reserving `OutputPathReservations.freePath`.
- Anything else gets `403 path_rejected`.
- When it applies: always without a token. With a token, only once `allowedDirectories` is set, because the apps let owners type any folder on a remote device. This follows the task-transfer plan's open question 5 ("behind a server flag").
- `DownloadTask.outputPath` (defaults to `null`) lets the server check what `deleteFiles` would remove.
- The policy is public in `core/file`, so the task-transfer import can reuse it. The plan now notes what exists and what remains.

**Requests and auth**
- JSON bodies go through `receiveJson`, which reads at most 1 MiB, or 32 MiB for `POST /api/tasks` (a resolved torrent carries Base64 metainfo and up to 10k files). Longer bodies get 413.
- Non-JSON bodies get 415. Uploaded content still has its 16 MiB cap, and pairing its 4 KiB cap.
- Tokens are compared in constant time (SHA-256 digests, `MessageDigest.isEqual`).
- An address that sends 10 wrong tokens within a minute gets 429 with `Retry-After` for any token until the minute ends (`AuthThrottle`).

**Apps:** the desktop and Android servers pass `allowedDirectories` through. Sharing already creates a token, so they keep working unchanged.

**Docs:** `cli/README.md` (Access token, Save folders and Request limits sections), the Daemon Server section of `AGENTS.md`, `docs/architecture.md`, the browser-extension README, the config template, and `docs/plans/task-transfer.md`.

## Notes for reviewers

- **Merged with main:** this branch first added its own file-name sanitizer to the engine. #364 landed the same fix, so the merge keeps main's `sanitizeFileName()`, `OutputPathReservations` and `DownloadExecution`, and the policy reuses them.
- **Behavior changes:**
  - Explicit `--token` users without `--cors` now get CORS `*`.
  - A token-less server refuses client paths outside its folders. `TorrentRemoteTest` and the server test helper now allow their temp folders for this reason.
- **Throttle:** clients behind one address, such as a reverse proxy, share the failure count.
- **Not covered:** `confine` picks a free path but does not reserve it, so a small race with downloads that start before the task runs remains.
- **Follow-up:** `RemoteKetch` currently surfaces these refusals as a bare "HTTP 403: Forbidden". Showing the server's message is a separate task.

## Testing

- `./gradlew allJvmTests -PprebuiltWebDir=/nonexistent` on the merged tree: all modules pass.
- Core compiles for JS, WasmWasi and iOS; `:app:android:compileDebugKotlin` passed before the merge.
- New tests:
  - `DestinationPathPolicyTest`, including symlinks and dangling links
  - `DestinationGuardTest`, `AuthThrottleTest`, `RequestBodiesTest` (server)
  - `ServerTokenTest` (CLI)
  - config tests for `allowedDirectories`
- Smoke test of the installed CLI against a throwaway home folder:
  - first run creates a `rw-------` token file
  - requests get 401 without the token and 200 with it
  - restart reuses the token
  - 429 with `Retry-After` after 10 wrong tokens
  - `--no-token` prints the warning and gives 403 `path_rejected` for an outside path and for `../` traversal
  - relative paths are rebased into the download folder
  - a 2 MB config body gets 413

title: fix(ktor): keep request headers on their origin across redirects
body:
## Summary

Three HTTP request fixes, plus header options for the CLI and MCP.

### 1. Header leak across redirects
Downloads followed redirects with Ktor's `HttpRedirect` plugin, which copies every request header to the next hop and strips only `Authorization` on a cross-authority redirect. Cookies, `Referer` and custom credential headers from `DownloadRequest.headers` (the browser extension forwards cookies and the referring page) reached the redirect target on the probe and on every segment GET.

`KtorHttpEngine` now follows redirects itself, on a copy of its client with `followRedirects = false`:
- At most 20 hops. Redirects from HTTPS to HTTP, or to non-HTTP schemes, are refused.
- A hop to another scheme, host or port keeps only `User-Agent`, `Accept`, `Accept-Encoding`, `Accept-Language` and `Referer` cut to its origin, and drops URL user info. This is a keep-list, not a drop-list, because custom credential headers can't be recognised by name. Like curl, an http→https upgrade on the same host also drops cookies.
- `RedirectCache` (per engine, 30 minutes, 64 entries) remembers each request's final target and the headers that hop was allowed:
  - HEAD and probes always follow the redirects and refresh it.
  - Segment GETs go straight to the cached target, so they hit the mirror that answered the probe.
  - When the target fails (for example an expired signed link), the next request follows the redirects again.

### 2. Default User-Agent
No client set a User-Agent, so CIO, OkHttp and Darwin sent `ktor-client`. The engine now sends `Ketch/<VERSION>` (`KtorHttpEngine.DEFAULT_USER_AGENT`) unless the request headers name one. It's configurable through `userAgent` on the engine and its network-bound factories; `null` leaves it to the client. This makes the add sheet's "Ketch" choice accurate, though a remote device on an older version still sends `ktor-client`.

### 3. Refused HEAD probe
A refused HEAD became a non-retryable `KetchError.Http`, so URLs presigned for GET only failed on fresh start, `resolve()` and resume.
- New `HttpEngine.probe()`: a GET with `Range: bytes=0-0` whose body is never read.
  - Reads the total size from `Content-Range`.
  - Treats a server that ignores the range as having no range support.
  - Treats a 416 with `bytes */0` as an empty file.
- `RangeSupportDetector` uses it when HEAD returns 400, 403, 404, 405 or 501.
- The default `probe()` throws `UnsupportedOperationException`, so third-party engines keep the HEAD error. `MultiNetworkHttpEngine` and `ConfigurableNetworkHttpEngine` delegate it.

### Header validation (`RequestHeaders`, core)
- `Ketch.download` rejects header names that aren't tokens and values with CR, LF or other control characters, with messages that never repeat the value. Previously Ktor's own exception included the value, and the engine logged it and wrapped it as a retryable network error.
- Engines ignore caller-supplied `Host`, `Range`, `Content-Length` and hop-by-hop headers.
- Validation sits in `Ketch.download`, not in `DownloadRequest`'s constructor, because `SqliteTaskStore` decodes saved records without guarding errors. One invalid old record would otherwise stop all tasks from loading.

### CLI and MCP
- `ketch -H 'Name: value'` (repeatable), `--user-agent` and `--referer`. Only header names are printed.
- The MCP `startDownload` tool gains `headers`, one `Name: value` per line.

## Notes for review
- Including 404 in the fallback set changed one existing test. The `NOT_FOUND` loopback fixture answered 404 only to HEAD while GET still served the file, so the download now succeeded. The fixture's GET now returns 404 too, as a really missing file would. Real missing files still fail, now with the GET's 404, after one extra request.
- A client passed in that has `HttpRedirect` installed explicitly (not through `followRedirects`) would still follow redirects itself. That case is left alone.

## Testing
- `./gradlew allJvmTests` passes.
- These compile: `:library:core` and `:library:ktor` iOS simulator tests, `:library:ktor` Android main (and its Android host tests pass), `:library:core` JS and WasmWasi.
- New tests:
  - Core, using `FakeHttpEngine`: the HEAD→GET fallback, download and resume through the probe, `RequestHeaders`, and `Ketch.download` rejecting bad headers.
  - Ktor, using `MockEngine`: dropping credentials on cross-origin redirects (with a check that no secret is logged), refused redirects, the 20-hop limit, cache reuse, forgetting and fallback, User-Agent, ignored headers, and the probe.
  - `RedirectCacheTest`: expiry and least-recently-used eviction.
  - Real loopback connections: a redirect to another port (`KtorHttpEngineRedirectTest`), and a server that answers HEAD with 403 (`download_headForbidden_probesWithRangedGet`).
  - CLI argument parsing and the MCP `headers` parameter.
- Not run: the opt-in public download tests, the iOS simulator tests, and a GraalVM native build. The new MCP parameter is a `String`, and the reflection config already covers all of `KetchToolSet`'s methods.

title: Fix the warnings in the CI build
body:
CI hid most compiler warnings: its compile tasks usually come from Gradle's build cache, which doesn't replay them. I ran CI's own command from clean, with the cache off and `--warning-mode all`, and fixed what it reported.

**Workflows**
- `actions/upload-artifact@v5` → `@v7` in every workflow. v5 runs on Node 20, which GitHub has deprecated; its steps printed that warning plus Node's `punycode` and `url.parse()` warnings. v7 runs on Node 24 and takes the same inputs; its one new input, `archive`, defaults to the current behaviour.
- The emulator warned "ACTION REQUIRED" about sending usage data, and says it will prompt before starting in a later release. `emulator-options` now adds `-no-metrics` to the runner's defaults (`ci.yml`, `store-screenshots.yml`).

**Kotlin**
- `QueueViewModel`: an unnecessary `?.`; `playingHere` already means `playing` isn't null.
- `DownloadFolderDialog`: `context.getExternalFilesDirs` instead of the deprecated `ContextCompat` wrapper. The minimum SDK has the method.
- `AppShell`: `currentWindowAdaptiveInfoV2()`, which also knows large and extra-large widths.
- The Compose tests use the v2 `createComposeRule` / `createAndroidComposeRule`. These queue coroutines rather than running them immediately, and every unit test passes with them.

**Java.** The compiler now names each deprecated API used (`-Xlint:deprecation`), instead of printing a note that some file uses one.
- Both `Handler`s are given their looper: the main one, and the connection thread's.
- The download-finished notification gets its channel.
- The version code comes from `PackageInfoCompat.getLongVersionCode`.
- The default preferences are opened by name: the same file `PreferenceManager` opened.
- `ConnectivityManager.getAllNetworks()` stays, with the warning suppressed and a comment on why. Its replacement, `NetworkCallback`, reports networks as they come and go, and this needs all the networks there now, including Wi-Fi under a VPN.
- In `LocalNetworkAddressTest`, the warning is suppressed on one helper: Robolectric's `addNetwork` still takes the deprecated `NetworkInfo`.

**Lint**
- `booleanSetting`: renamed, as composables that return a value start lowercase.
- `LocalResources.current` replaces `LocalContext.current.resources`.
- `String.toUri()` replaces `Uri.parse`.
- kotlinx-coroutines 1.9.0 → 1.11.0, and uiautomator 2.3.0 → 2.4.0.
- The widget's `targetCellWidth`/`targetCellHeight` are marked as intentionally Android 12+; older versions size it from `minWidth`/`minHeight`.
- The baseline is regenerated, dropping 180 entries for issues since fixed.
- Kotlin 2's `.kotlin/` caches are ignored.

**Left as they are**
- `OldTargetApi`: `targetSdk` is 36, and `compileSdk` is 37. Raising it opts into Android 17's behaviour changes, so it's a separate decision. It stays reported, not baselined.
- Gradle's `Configuration.setVisible` deprecation: it comes from the Android Gradle plugin itself (`BasePlugin`, `SourceSetManager`), and 9.4.1 is its latest stable version.
- `lintVitalPlayRelease`'s note that the baseline is for another build type: it runs only lint's fatal checks against the same baseline.
- The emulator's own start-up messages (libX11, `.ini` files, netsim).

**Checked:** CI's command (`lintFdroidDebug testFdroidDebugUnitTest assembleFdroidDebug bundlePlayRelease`, plus the device tests' compile) passes with no compiler warnings, and lint reports only `OldTargetApi`. The `device` job here covers the v2 rule in `AccessibilityDeviceTest` and uiautomator 2.4.0.

title: Fix Clementine discovery with auto-connect on or a VPN up
body:
The connect screen never found Clementine on the local network. This was seen on a Galaxy Z Flip3 (Android 15) running Tailscale, with build 13-dev+bf88b4d. Clementine was advertising correctly: avahi-browse showed `_clementine._tcp` on the LAN. The problem was two bugs in the app.

1. **Auto-connect suppressed discovery.** `ConnectActivity.onResume` either auto-connected or started discovery, never both.
   - With auto-connect on and a saved address that no longer worked (here a Tailscale address), the user got "Could not reach host" and nothing to pick from.
   - On the device, the app never took a multicast lock.
   - Discovery now always runs, and auto-connect happens alongside it. A successful connect stops discovery, as before.
2. **Discovery listened on the wrong interface.** `JmDNS.create(ip)` was bound to `Utilities.getIp4Address()`, the first non-loopback IPv4 address of any interface.
   - With a VPN up, that can be `tun0` (Tailscale, 100.x). With mobile data on, it can be `rmnet*`. Multicast DNS crosses neither.
   - It now uses `Utilities.getLocalNetworkIp4Address(Context)`: the IPv4 address of a Wi-Fi or Ethernet network from `ConnectivityManager`.
   - VPN networks are excluded explicitly, because a VPN can also report the Wi-Fi it runs over as a transport.

jmDNS failures were swallowed (`catch (Exception e) { mJmDNS = null; }`). They are now logged, along with the address discovery listens on, or the fact that there is no local network.

The saved Tailscale address failing to connect is a separate, Clementine-side issue. With "Only allow connections from the local network" on, Clementine rejects Tailscale's 100.64.0.0/10 IPv4 range. Clementine PR #7515 is about that.

## Testing
- **`LocalNetworkAddressTest`** (Robolectric) sets up the phone's networks through the shadow `ConnectivityManager`:
  - Tailscale (VPN plus Wi-Fi transports, 100.68.237.114) and mobile data are listed before Wi-Fi, and 192.168.86.207 is picked.
  - Ethernet is used when present.
  - With only VPN and mobile data, there is no address.
  - With the VPN check removed, the first case fails.
- `lintFdroidDebug testFdroidDebugUnitTest assembleFdroidDebug bundlePlayRelease assembleFdroidDebugAndroidTest` passes locally, with no new lint issues.
- **Not yet tried on the phone.** Once this merges, the next internal-testing build will carry it. With Tailscale on, the connect screen should list "Clementine on zem".

A later step could move discovery to `NsdManager`, which on Android 14+ uses the platform's mDNS and handles interfaces itself.

title: fix(daemon): announce the raw OpenSession workdir in SessionLive (#219)
body:
## 问题描述

升级到 **1.7.0** 后，手机 App **新建会话**时提示「会话没有打开——电脑未响应」，8 秒后超时。1.6 版本正常。该问题在**自建中继（self-hosted relay）**环境下复现（本 PR 即自建中继用户报告并修复），官方 relay 用户理论上同样受影响。

## 根因分析

1. 1.7 手机 App 新增了 #219 的 `acceptsSessionLive` 身份守卫（`mobile/.../PocketRepository.kt`）：新建会话（`resumeId == null`）没有 sessionId 可识别，因此用 `f.workdir == pendingNewOpenWd` 做**精确字符串匹配**来判断「这是我要打开的会话」（1.6 手机无条件接受 SessionLive，无此守卫）。
2. 手机从「~」（home）锚点新建会话时，`OpenSession.workdir` 传的是**原始 `"~/xxx"` 形式**（`DirectoryPicker.browseWorkdirOf` = `joinNative("~", subPath)`，注释明确 "the raw ~ form the daemon expands"）。
3. daemon 侧 `validateWorkdir` 对 workdir 做 `expandTilde` + `toRealPath()` 规范化（`DirectoryService.kt`），因此 `SessionLive.workdir` 返回的是绝对路径 `"C:\Users\admin\xxx"`。
4. `"C:\Users\admin\xxx" != "~/xxx"` → 守卫条件**永远不满足** → 手机丢弃 SessionLive → 8 秒超时 → 显示「电脑未响应」。

从磁盘根锚点（如 `C:\`）打开项目时 workdir 是绝对路径，不会触发；从「~」锚点新建会话必现。

## 修复内容（daemon 侧，3 个文件）

让 `SessionLive.workdir` **回显手机在 OpenSession 中发出的原始 workdir**（可能是 `"~/xxx"` 原始形式），而不是规范化后的绝对路径：

- `daemon/.../conversation/Conversation.kt`：新增 `announcedWorkdir: String? = null` 构造参数；`live()` 用 `announcedWorkdir ?: workdir.toString()` 构造 `SessionLive.workdir`
- `daemon/.../session/SessionRegistry.kt`：`open()` 透传 `announcedWorkdir` 到 Conversation
- `daemon/.../server/RequestRouter.kt`：`registry.open(..., announcedWorkdir = frame.workdir)` —— 传手机发来的原始 workdir

`announcedWorkdir` 默认 `null`（未传时行为不变，回退到规范化 workdir），不影响其他调用方（scheduler/headless 等）。

## 验证

- `./gradlew :daemon:installDist` BUILD SUCCESSFUL
- 替换 daemon 主 jar 后，手机新建会话（「~」锚点）正常打开，不再超时
- daemon `attached`，relay 正常

## 备注（关于 main 分支）

仓库公开的 `main` 分支目前停在 **1.5.2**（2026-07-26），而 v1.7.0 是在 release 流程中发布的（2026-08-07）。本 PR 基于 **v1.7.0**，相对 `main` 的 diff 较大；建议维护者直接 cherry-pick 本修复的 3 个文件改动（`announcedWorkdir` 相关，共 +11/-1 行），或合入后同步 release。

title: fix(codex): release session writer after turns (#316)
body:
## Summary

- end the cc-pocket-owned Codex app-server at a stable idle boundary so ChatGPT can resume the same thread
- lazily resume the existing thread on the next cc-pocket prompt
- preserve prompt ordering and exactly-once delivery across the turn-completed/process-exit race
- release the writer after native compact responses as well as normal/review turns
- extend the real app-server probe with consumption-receipt and cross-process handoff checks

## Issue

- #316
- Keeps the issue open until a formally verified release contains the fix.

## Validation

- `JAVA_HOME=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@17 ./gradlew :daemon:test --tests dev.ccpocket.daemon.codex.CodexBackendTest --tests dev.ccpocket.daemon.conversation.ConversationOpenCodeOneShotTest`
- `bash scripts/check-all.sh` — protocol + daemon + relay + mobile Desktop all green
- ChatGPT bundled Codex `0.150.0-alpha.8`: handoff probe 10/10
- local Codex `0.145.0`: handoff probe 10/10
- installed development daemon logs show repeated clean `one-shot process completed normally` boundaries with a single relay-connected daemon

## Risk review

- no protocol or relay wire change
- single-writer protection remains intact; the daemon only shuts down the child app-server it launched
- active bridge authority is revoked at the completed turn; a staged grant remains inert until its exact prompt replay
- clean EOF is attempted first, with the existing bounded TERM/KILL fallback serialized against concurrent shutdowns
- unconsumed prompts remain in the daemon ledger and are replayed in order after a clean relaunch

## Not run

- iOS Simulator tests: the default merge gate excludes them, and this change has no protocol/mobile runtime edits.

title: fix: dsh 会话状态与提问作答、Windows 托盘、缓存命中口径 (#320 #321 #322 #323)
body:
发仔 08-27 的四条反馈，外加一条无关但已就绪的额度条修复（单独 commit）。

## #320 dsh 会话头只显示 default、看不到 context
新增 `AgentEvent.RuntimeMeta` 承载后端「在自己 wire 上实测到」的会话元信息。dsh 从 `request/context`（contextWindow）、`request/header`（reasoningEffort）与 `assistant/message`（source.model + usage）三处上报；`Conversation` 据此补齐 `SessionLive` 的 model/effort/contextWindow，且只在真的变化时重新 announce。

- ⚠️ `request/header.config.maxTokens` 是**输出上限**（同一模型上报 256k，而窗口是 1,000,000），明确不当 context 窗口用。
- DeepSeek 是 OpenAI 血统，`cacheReadTokens ⊂ inputTokens`，而 `TokenUsage.contextTokens` 把四列当互斥相加——所以减掉缓存前缀，否则占用翻倍。与磁盘侧 `DshUsageScanner` 同一套归一化。
- 非 Claude 后端拿不到模型时显示「未知」而非 default：default 只对**有账号默认档**的 Claude 成立。

## #321 dsh AskUserQuestion 只能看不能答（P1）
实时链路本身查证是好的（帧→卡片有单测、桌面端渲染的确是可作答卡、dsh 仍是 rc.6 无漂移）。修的是两条能产生同样症状的确凿缺陷：

- 回放里**未作答**的 AskUserQuestion 原本落到通用工具卡，看着像提问却点不动、也没有一个字说明为什么。新增 `ChatItem.QuestionsUnanswered` 明确标注。与后端无关——被打断的 Claude 回合留下的是同一种残留。
- dsh **没有任何超时**，被丢弃的 ask ＝ 该回合永久挂起，而此前唯一痕迹是一行手机上看不到的 daemon 日志。无法作答的丢弃改为在会话里明说。
- resume 时 host 会在 mux 订阅那一刻重放待决 ask，早于 `openSession` 写入 `sessionId`，fail-closed 检查会丢掉本属自己的 ask。`ourSessionId()` 用 `resumeId` 兜住该窗口；**新建会话仍严格 fail-closed**（create 返回前我们的会话尚不存在，任何 ask 都不可能是我们的）。

## #322 Windows 托盘右键无响应、浮层圆角与按钮层级失真
- 右键接 AWT 原生 `PopupMenu`（**仅 Windows**，mac/Linux 一字未动）。自绘 Compose 菜单在多屏 + 任务栏靠侧边时必然错位。
- Windows 走透明窗口，圆角/描边/投影由浮层自绘：skiko 建透明窗口在 macOS 26 必崩是 **macOS 独有**约束，而 Win11 的 DWM 不给无 caption 窗口补圆角，不透明底会把 8dp 圆角填回直角。拿不到逐像素透明时退回原不透明方角，不让托盘把整个 App 带崩。
- 页脚收敛成两级：主操作实心 accent，退出为次级纯文字。

## #323 缓存命中率长期只有 50–60%
本机同口径对拍：**Claude 99%、Codex 96%**，排除解析错误。真正的问题是这一页把六个后端混合聚合却从不说明覆盖了谁，也无法追溯回原始 token 字段。**公式一字未改**（issue 明令不得为接近 90% 人为调整）：

- `Usage` 尾部追加 `cacheReadTokensWindow` / `cacheBaseTokensWindow`（纯追加可选字段，老 daemon 解为 null 的用例已钉死）。
- 缓存卡标签带上 agent 维度（含显式「全部 agent」），并打印原始分子/分母。
- daemon 不支持按 agent 过滤时明说这是全机合计——那正是读者连点都点不出来的最坏情况。
- 标签跟着**已到达的回复**走而不是 chip，避免切换 agent 时新名字盖在旧数字上。

## 额外：额度条每晚消失（单独 commit）
`QuotaCredential.Expired` 原被映射成权威语义的 `NO_TOKEN`，客户端据此清掉快照。但 OAuth token 只是在最后一次 claude 运行后 ~8h 过期、下次一跑就续上——改判为暂态的 `NETWORK`，客户端保留正在变旧的快照。

## 验证
`bash scripts/check-all.sh` 全绿（就是本分支这两个 commit 的状态）：protocol 265 / daemon 1743 / relay 54 / mobile-desktop 1130，0 失败 0 错误 0 跳过。

## ⚠️ 未做的验收
**#322 没有 Windows 真机验收**（开发机是 macOS）。右键菜单弹不弹、透明窗圆角在正式安装包里长什么样、Win11 上页脚层级读不读得出，目前只有构建与 headless 测试撑着。issue 明文要求的截图与点击路径回归仍欠。

**#321 未能复现反馈者的具体路径**——修的是两条能产生同样症状的缺陷，不是确认过的那一条。已在小红书私信向发仔索取实时/回放路径、新开/恢复会话、以及 `%USERPROFILE%\.cc-pocket\logs\daemon.log` 里 dsh 相关行。

title: fix(appstore): complete and verify iPhone and iPad screenshot synchronization
body:
Uploading the new iPad screenshot set could fail when App Store Connect's collection read had not caught up with completed uploads and ordering. The failure stopped the second locale, while the final verification covered only iPhone screenshots.

The workflow now preserves correct screenshots, retries collection reads for a bounded time, and independently verifies all 24 screenshots across both locales and device families by processing state, order, and source checksum. Failed asset processing still fails immediately. A read-only verification input and per-version concurrency make inspection and retries safe.

Validation: four focused Ruby tests (25 assertions), Ruby syntax checks, workflow YAML parsing, and the complete local App Store content check passed. A read-only ASC run confirmed the existing English iPad set was correct and the Chinese iPad set was missing: https://github.com/heypandax/cc-pocket/actions/runs/34139781299. The live sync and independent verification passed in https://github.com/heypandax/cc-pocket/actions/runs/34140016906: 24 ordered screenshots and two processed previews. The new Chinese iPad uploads reproduced the root cause: COMPLETE assets initially returned null source checksums; read-only polling converged after 10 seconds. PR CI also passed on the exact head.

Related to #334. No App Review submission or binary rebuild is performed by this workflow.

title: fix(desktop): 分屏与焦点会话全面平权——认领次序、委托定界、提问承接与机器下沉 (#311)
body:
## 背景

PR #327 落地了 #311 的桌面分屏主线。合并后的深度审查（8 个查找角度＋对抗验证轮）确认了一批「pane 与焦点路径平权」缺口，本 PR 按四个工作包逐一修复。审查中唯一后置的回合机 watchdog 已单独录为 #329。

Closes #311

## 四个 commit 对应四个工作包

**W1　会话认领与生命周期（dfac0af1）**
- 不变量确立：一个会话绝不同时出现在焦点区与分屏列。`openSession` 咽喉点先把同会话的列摘除（`releaseToFocus`），任何入口（侧栏点击／pin／推送／deep-link）聚焦已分屏会话都统一为「提升」语义——修掉「点击侧栏行 → SessionLive 被列抢走 → 主区永卡 Opening／open failed」。
- `reopenAll` 重置列回 opening 态再重开：daemon 重启后新 convoId 可正常重绑（原先列会永久冻结、主区为空时还会被 catch-all 劫持），顺带消掉「opening 与 openFailed 同真」矛盾态。
- 在途 open 被关闭的孤儿回收：`disowned` 记账，迟到的 SessionLive 回以 CloseSession，不再不请自来地开进空主区。
- `demoteToSatellite` 补 `sidePanes.clear()`：fleet 热切换不再把列的会话漏在卫星链路上被幽灵重开。

**W2　委托穿透封堵（aa9b81d1）**
- `SidePaneModel` 补齐定界：`stopTurn` 按列的 convoId 发 CancelTurn（原先 ■ 按钮打断的是焦点会话）；附件全家桶、rewind／handoff 横幅、ask 心跳、会话身份字段等 20 个成员显式 PANE_INERT（原先焦点会话上传中会禁用所有列的发送按钮）。
- 裁决直达 wire：新增 `resolveAskDirect`——verdict 无条件发送（原先收件箱行缺失时点 Allow 无声无息什么都不发）、`remember` 如实转发（原先「始终允许」被静默降级为一次性放行）、task-grant／retry-safer 按列的 ask 定址（原先卡显示列的 ask、按钮裁决焦点的 ask）。
- 防复发守卫：`SidePaneModelDelegationGuardTest` 反射枚举 `DesktopModel` 全部 338 个成员，强制归类 PANE_SCOPED／PANE_INERT／WINDOW_DELEGATED——未来新增成员不显式分类即红。

**W3　AskUserQuestion 承接（c32964b9）**
- 列会话发起的提问原先在任何界面都不渲染（v1.9.5 刚修完的丢 ask 类别一列之隔重现），现在与审批一样进列的卡槽，ChatPane 零改动即可作答。
- ask 生命周期对齐焦点路径：M1 排队（第二个 ask 不再顶掉未决卡、reattach resurface 原位刷新）、#100 超时终态（卡保留「已超时」而非无声消失）、question 撤回留注记、SessionGone 清仓。
- 答题动词 `answerQuestionsDirect`／`skipQuestionsDirect` 与焦点路径共用一份 wire 构造（updatedInput.answers map 形状逐字段一致，有测试比对钉死）。

**W4　机器下沉与收尾（626573b2）**
- `bind()` 补 `finishThinking`：reattach 报 idle 时盖章未完的 Thinking 块（原先永远转「Thinking…」，下一回合还会盖上荒谬时长）。
- 回合／历史机器收归一份：`ChatTranscript.endTurn`／`mergeHistory` 下沉，焦点与列共用（原先逐句复制、已开始漂移）；`reset()` 接上会话边界；open 超时常量两路共享。
- `EndedPane` 复用泛化后的 `ChatNotice`，动作胶囊补 `tightCenter` 铁律并拿回 hoverFill。
- 删除死状态 `SidePane.composer`；`finishThinking` 折进 `onToolEvent` 让配对约定变成结构。

## 验证

- 全量 `scripts/check-all.sh` 四套件全绿；`:mobile:composeApp:desktopTest` 147 类 1197 条（较基线净增 28 条，含枚举守卫、wire 逐字段比对、竞态钉死用例）。
- 每包均做过「撤销修复 → 测试变红」的非空洞性验证。
- 待真机目验（无法单测断言）：分屏三主链路（点击聚焦、daemon 重启重绑、列内答题）与 `ChatNotice` 胶囊的视觉对齐。

title: fix(observability): close mobile diagnostics and analytics gaps
body:
Android 重新进入 App 时，旧根界面的生命周期回调可能错误地把新界面使用的 FleetCoordinator 切到后台，造成会话打开超时。本次让每个 App 根界面持有自己的 fleet，统一 primary/satellite 的前后台转发，并使用 singleTask 避免重复 Activity。

GA4 手机普通聚合的 analytics_schema 维度曾因整数值 1 无法按预期使用而遗漏事件；公共字段改为字符串 v1，并保持耗时为数值。iOS handled 错误补充安全 Kotlin/Native 帧提取：只保留项目符号及运行时确实提供的源码 basename/正整数行号；新增 Cocoa 采集关闭时取消上传、重新开启不重放的测试。

同时归档现有脱敏验收证据、事件口径及 GitHub 发布配置说明。桌面 GA4 后续需求文档仅保留本地，不包含在本 PR；该服务端入口尚未实现。

验证复用已完成结果：Android 生命周期/会话定向测试 23 项；安全栈相关 JVM 27 项、Native 26 项；Cocoa 6 项；GA4 metadata 5 项。Android 真机会话打开与文件读取已有成功回执，98 条手机事件的 GA4 普通聚合已核对。本次合并未补跑设备或云端验证，正常 CI 保留。

新 schema=v1 包的云端回执、iOS 真机源码行号及成熟留存尚未验证，按本次收尾约定后续观察或另行安排。Crashlytics 保持现状；本 PR 不触发公开发布、部署或服务重启。

title: fix(daemon): 明文 http 网关解禁模型探测，选择器显示网关真实模型清单 (#343)
body:
关联 #343（合并不代表发布；issue 保留 open，待正式发版验证后关闭）

## 命题

`GatewayModelProbe` 曾拒绝向非 loopback 的明文 http 网关发探测请求（[GatewayModelProbe.kt](https://github.com/heypandax/cc-pocket/blob/main/daemon/src/main/kotlin/dev/ccpocket/daemon/claude/GatewayModelProbe.kt) `attempt()` 里的 `http && !isLoopback(host)` 守卫）。公司内网网关恰恰是明文 http + 非 loopback 域名——探测被静默拒绝，模型选择器回退到方向③（本机 transcript 历史模型 id），用户看到的是陈旧或无关的名字，而不是改了 API 之后网关实际提供的模型。

审核后接受的边界（已落实于 `af93faf2`）：用户显式配置远程 `http://` 网关，视为选择了明文传输。模型探测可能在首个 Claude turn 之前触发，因此是额外的携凭证请求，不应称为「零新增暴露面」。探测只发往配置目标、只发送同层凭证类型对应的单一 header；「成对解析」用于防止凭证配错主机，不提供传输加密。

## 改动

- 删除 `attempt()` 的 `http + 非 loopback` 拒绝与 `isLoopback()` 辅助函数。
- KDoc 不变量 3 与审核建议对齐：明确额外携凭证请求、用户选择明文传输的风险取舍，以及配置目标和单一凭证 header 边界。
- 测试：`plaintextOnlyToLoopback` → `plaintextHttpToRemoteGatewayProbes`（断言对远程明文网关会发出请求、URI 正确、解析出模型 id）。

## 不变的边界

- 成对解析、scheme 白名单（`file://` 仍拒绝）、禁 redirect、单 header（按凭证变量拼写选一）、大小上限、负缓存全部不动；官方端点行为不动（仍解析为 null、不探测）。
- mobile/desktop 零改动：`gatewayRowsFrom()` 已能对未知 id 合成行。

## 验证

- `:daemon:test` 相关两组用例 25 个全绿（含新用例实际执行确认）。
- 真实网关冒烟：用生产同款 `resolvePaired` → `GatewayModelProbe.fetch()` 路径对本机配置的明文公司网关探测，拿到全部 5 个模型 id。
- 本地部署 1.9.6（含本修复）后，desktop 端到端：模型选择器正确列出网关真实模型，选定并发送消息成功。

title: fix(installer): don't abort first-time Windows install on missing scheduled task
body:
## Problem
First-time Windows install aborts at the `schtasks /End` step:

    schtasks : 错误: 系统找不到指定的文件。
    所在位置 行:73 字符: 1
    + schtasks /End /TN cc-pocket-daemon 2>$null | Out-Null

## Root cause
`$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"` (top of script) turns a native command's stderr
into a *terminating* error in Windows PowerShell 5.1, so `2>$null` can't swallow
the "task not found" error from `schtasks /End /TN cc-pocket-daemon` when the task
isn't scheduled yet (first install). The script then aborts before the daemon is
ever registered — nothing gets installed.

## Fix
Guard the `schtasks /End` with `Get-ScheduledTask` so it only runs when the task
actually exists:

```powershell
if (Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName cc-pocket-daemon -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
    schtasks /End /TN cc-pocket-daemon 2>$null | Out-Null
}
```

## Verification
- Syntax-checked via `[scriptblock]::Create` (no parse errors).
- On Windows PowerShell 5.1 (5.1.26100): with `$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"`,
  the guard skips cleanly when no task is scheduled (first install) and the script
  continues; `schtasks /End` returns exit 0 on an existing task (running or not).
- No `check-all.sh` run — this is a pure PowerShell installer change, outside the

title: fix(daemon): Kimi ACP 后端保真度——wire 回放重写、工具卡内容、中途排队、审批描述
body:
背景
1.7.0 接入的 Kimi Code 后端（#206）在发布时因设备码登录阻塞从未在登录态下活体实测——设计文档 §9 的 V2/V3/V10 等关键项全是「待验证」，两处核心假设是按 ACP spec 推断的。本次在 kimi 0.34.0 已登录环境下做了全链路 probe（新增 scripts/probe-kimi-acp.py，设计文档 §9 已回填实测结果），并在真实客户端（HarmonyOS 移植版）上实测暴露了 4 个缺陷。两个设计假设被实测推翻。

实测发现与修复
1. 会话历史回放产出 0 行：wire.jsonl 不是 ACP
假设（错）：~/.kimi-code/sessions/**/wire.jsonl 落盘的是 ACP session/update 帧，回放与 live 共用 KimiAcpParser。
实测：落盘的是 CLI 内部 wire 格式——turn.prompt / context.append_message / context.append_loop_event{content.part, tool.call, tool.result} / llm.request / usage.record / turn.ended 等。旧解析每行都 miss，回放静默为空。
症状：attach/resume 一个 kimi 活会话，App 看不到 attach 点之前的任何历史。
修复：KimiTranscriptReplay 按实测格式重写——turn.prompt→用户行（避开 context.append_message 的 <system-reminder> 折叠）、content.part{type:text}→助手行（think 不入聊天行）、tool.call{name,args}→工具卡、tool.result{output,isError}→合并到卡。KimiTranscriptScanner.countChatRows 同步改数 turn.prompt（原来数的 user_message_chunk 在磁盘格式里不存在，messageCount 恒 0）。

2. 工具卡空白：tool_call 没有 rawInput
假设（错）：tool_call 按 ACP spec 携带完整 rawInput。
实测：tool_call 只有 title/kind/pending 状态；输入 JSON 以累积文本形式随 in_progress tool_call_update 的 content[].content.text 流式到来；输出在 settled 更新的 rawOutput——且是字符串原语而非对象。旧解析三处全错（obj("rawInput")→null、obj("rawOutput")→null、content 多包一层取不出）。
症状：App 上 Bash/Read 工具卡只有工具名，没有命令/路径/输出。
修复：KimiBackend 改为有状态累积（toolCallId → ToolAccum）：输入文本解析成完整 JSON 时才发 START（≈执行开始），settled 时发 ToolResult。KimiAcpParser 回归无状态（只翻 text/thought chunk），工具事件归 backend。

3. 轮中发消息 turn failed：ACP 没有 stdin 排队
实测：轮次进行中第二个 session/prompt 直接被拒——-32600 "another turn is already in progress"（turn.agent_busy）。Claude CLI 会自己排队 stdin 消息，ACP 不会；Conversation 按既有契约把 prompt 直接交给 backend，于是错误 TurnResult 冒泡到 App。
症状：App 显示「turn failed」；且错误 TurnResult 误清 executing，运行指示和 ■ 打断按钮一并消失（用户体感「没有暂停功能」）。
修复：KimiBackend 内做 in-flight 门闩＋FIFO 排队（promptIds 非空则入队，prompt 响应/错误落地后按序 flush）。行为对齐 Claude：不丢消息、不报错、不打断进行中的轮次。

4. 审批卡没有命令内容
实测：session/request_permission 的 toolCall 同样无 rawInput，命令只存在于 content 文本（"Requesting approval to Running: echo …"）。
修复：审批卡 description 取该 content 文本。
影响面
零外溢。diff 全部在 daemon/kimi/ 包内（+ 设计文档 + probe 脚本）：protocol/、Conversation、其他三后端零改动；包外引用点（Main.kt 工厂注册、DaemonCore、RequestRouter、DirectoryService）的公开签名全部不变，只动了内部实现。KimiJson 辅助函数为 internal 且仅包内使用。

测试
新增 KimiBackendTest 5 例（fake AgentIo 驱动合成 ACP 帧）：中途 FIFO 排队与错误不卡队、流式输入完整才发 START、rawOutput 结果、无输入 settle 兜底、审批描述。
KimiTranscriptReplayTest 按 probe 实录的 wire 格式夹具重写（旧夹具本身写的就是被推翻的错误格式）。
KimiAcpParserTest 移除工具分支用例（已移交 backend），保留 chunk 翻译。
:daemon:test 中 kimi.* + conversation.* 全绿。（Windows 本机另有 19 个测试类的环境固有失败——符号链接特权/POSIX 权限假设，与本改动无关，改动前后一致。）
真机回归通过：HarmonyOS 客户端 attach 活会话可见完整历史、工具卡有内容。
probe 脚本
scripts/probe-kimi-acp.py（入库）：驱动真实 kimi acp 跑 initialize→session/new→工具轮→轮中注入→cancel 全程并录制帧，自动应答审批。Kimi CLI 迭代极快且自更新默认开（tui.toml [upgrade].auto_install），升级后跑一遍即可回归协议漂移。

未覆盖（follow-up）
usage_update{used,size} → 上下文占用线（session.live contextUsed/Window）
session/new 响应的 configOptions（model/thinking/mode 选项）→ 会话内模型/模式切换，可去掉换模型必须 relaunch 的限制
plan 更新渲染、available_commands_update 接入指令目录、session_info_update 标题同步

title: fix(harmony/relay): #203 评审修复——心跳回显、E2E 串行化、convoId 门与 Push Kit v3
body:
## #203 评审修复：三个互通阻塞项 + 推送通道修正（供 @Xinkun-WANG 评估）

对 #203 做了全面评审（wire 兼容 + E2E 加密双路独立审查）。移植质量很高：wire 词汇表逐项对照 `protocol/` 未发现拼写或字节序错误，加密核心结构可靠（对端公钥曲线上验证、4-DH／HKDF／nonce 逐字节等价 JVM 参考实现）。但有三个会阻断与现网 1.6.0 稳定互通的问题，本 PR 基于 `feat/harmony-port`（＝#203 head 的镜像分支）逐项修复，diff 只含修复本身。采纳后可直接合进你的分支（#203 已开 maintainer edit），或 cherry-pick。

### 修复内容（三笔 commit 对应三个层面）

**1️⃣ relay（`5dcc5a45`，Kotlin，测试全绿）**
- **心跳必死修复**：现网 relay 的 device 腿 TEXT 控制面只处理 `RegisterPush`，`pocket/ping` 落 `else -> {}` 静默丢弃（Pong 回显只有 daemon 腿有）。鸿蒙端 10s 收不到 pong 即断连 → **每约 30 秒掉线循环**（真机测试大概率被 2s 快速重连＋会话自动重开掩盖了）。现在 device 腿在发起 socket 上回 `Pong`。
- **HuaweiSender 端点版本修正**：原实现是 HMS Android 旧端点 `v1/{appId}` 配 HarmonyOS v3 形状报文的混搭；HarmonyOS NEXT Push Kit 实际是 `v3/{projectId}/messages:send` ＋ 必填 `push-type: 0` 头（华为官方文档核实）。env 相应改为 `CCPOCKET_HUAWEI_PROJECT_ID`。
- **路由 data JSON 转义**：手拼 `"\"$k\":\"$v\""` 无转义，Windows daemon 的 workdir 含 `\` 时客户端 `JSON.parse` 必炸。改用 `buildJsonObject`（同 `FcmSender`）。
- 新增 `RelayServerControlTest`（Ping 回显）＋ `PushTest` 转义用例，`:relay:test` 全绿。

**2️⃣ harmony 网络／加密层（`c7b6f769`）**
- **E2E seal/open 串行化**：原来每帧 fire-and-forget `seal(...).then(send)`，AES 完成顺序无保证；daemon 计数器严格递增（`E2ESession.kt:34-41`），ctr=1 先上线则迟到的 ctr=0 被当重放**静默永久丢弃**——onReady 连发 4 帧和重连 flushOutbox 是高危窗口，症状是「列表偶尔拉不到」这类概率性失败。现在出／入站各一条 promise 链，取号顺序＝上线顺序、按到达顺序解密投递。
- **GCM 填充修正**：`AES256|GCM|PKCS7` → `NoPadding`。GCM 无填充；若 cryptoFramework 真按 PKCS7 生效则跨端解密必败，而自封自解 selfTest 两侧同错全绿测不出。`selfTest()` 新增 **JVM 参考实现生成的跨端 KAT**（逐字节断言 `ct‖tag`，44=28+16 同时钉死无填充与字节序）。
- pong 超时改连续 2 次未中才断连（配合 relay 回显，弱网少一次全量重连）。

**3️⃣ harmony 数据／UI 层（`d5d84a39`）**
- **会话域帧补 `convoId` 门**（history/chunk/tool/ask/turn.done/prompt.ack/file.uploaded…，对齐 mobile `PocketRepository` 逐帧过滤）：修会话切换窗口期 A 会话在途帧污染 B 会话转录（锚点合并还可能判「硬分叉」整体替换）、迟到 ask 顶掉当前审批卡。
- **重连不 fork**：自动 resume 收紧为「必须握有具体 sessionId」——新会话在 `session.live` 回填前断线重连，`resumeId=null` 会被 daemon 当开新会话（这仓库修过的「冗余会话＝fork」老病，115c79a）。
- **`session.gone` 按协议语义**（`Messages.kt:1097-1105` 的 auto-reopen **and resend**）：暂存最近 prompt，匹配才重开、`session.live` 后同 `promptId` 补发一次（daemon 去重），无 pending 则诚实报错不空转。
- **ClientCaps 纠偏**：`supportsAgents: ['opencode']` → `[]`。openSession 硬编码 `agent:'claude'`，谎报会让用户点 opencode 会话被以 claude resume → fork。后续支持时需把 agent 从 `SessionSummary` 透传进 OpenSession（README 已记）。
- **TranscriptMerge 移植 acc 连续消费**（`TranscriptMerge.kt:61-83`）：一条流式气泡跨多条回放行时不再被当断线回补重复追加。
- **AskUserQuestion 支持 `multiSelect`**：answers 值为选项原序 `", "` 连接（对齐 `QuestionCard.answerOf`）；原实现降级单选造成答案语义失真。
- README 与实现终态对齐，补 relay 部署顺序警告。

### 验证情况（诚实声明）

- ✅ relay／protocol：`:relay:test` `:protocol:jvmTest` 全绿（含新测试）。
- ✅ GCM KAT 由 JVM 参考实现生成，并经 Node `aes-256-gcm` 独立复算逐字节吻合。
- ⚠️ ArkTS 改动**未经编译验证**（本机无 DevEco 工具链）：语法严格模仿文件既有形态（promise 链显式返回类型、无解构、数组展开等均取自仓库已有先例），但请你在 DevEco 里编译并真机过一遍。
- ⚠️ 推送链路仍未真机端到端验证（依赖 AGC 凭据），v3 端点按官方文档修正，`clickAction`/`data` 的落点请在真机首验时确认。

### 建议的验收硬条件

真机对现网 1.6.0 daemon（relay 需先合入本分支并 redeploy）：完整握手 → 一轮收发 → **挂机 5 分钟不掉线**（验证心跳）→ 快速连发多条消息（验证串行化）→ 会话间快速切换（验证 convoId 门）。

### 已知未修（评审发现、非阻塞，留后续）

明文存储迁 HUKS／Asset Store（你已列 TODO；配对 ticket 也一并迁）、离线期 outbox prompt 丢失、`K_FIRST_TICKET` 单槽多电脑窗口、token 空注销、断线上传误导文案、delta 分支盲追加（当前死代码）、AskUserQuestion 自由文本回复入口、`HistoryMessage` answers 回放摘要。

title: fix(windows): resolve claude.cmd instead of POSIX shell script
body:
## Problem

On Windows, npm-installed `claude` is a POSIX `#!/bin/sh` shell script. Java's `ProcessBuilder` cannot execute POSIX scripts on Windows (CreateProcess error 193: "not a valid Win32 application").

When the phone opens a session, the daemon tries to launch `claude`, fails with error 193, the exception propagates up and crashes the relay WebSocket connection — causing the phone to disconnect. **Both relay mode and direct LAN mode are affected.**

## Changes

### Bug 1: `ClaudeLauncher.kt` — Windows executable resolution
- On Windows, prefer `.cmd`/`.bat` wrappers over POSIX `#!` scripts
- POSIX scripts cannot be executed by `ProcessBuilder` on Windows
- `.cmd` files (generated by npm) are valid Windows executables

### Bug 2: `DeviceSessions.kt` + `WsConnection.kt` — error propagation
- `router.handle()` exceptions should not crash the transport
- Wrapped in try-catch, emit `PocketError` to the phone instead
- Applies to both relay path (DeviceSessions) and direct LAN path (WsConnection)

### Improvement: `Main.kt` — LAN mode UX
- `--local` mode now auto-detects the LAN IP address
- Prints a usable `ws://<lan-ip>:port/v1/ws` URL instead of `ws://0.0.0.0`
- Renders a terminal QR code for easy phone scanning

## Tested on
- Windows 10 x64
- npm-installed Claude Code v2.1.153
- cc-pocket daemon v0.1.0
- Android CC Pocket app

title: fix: distinguish API compatibility build failures in CI diagnostics
body:
## Summary

The enforce step now receives ANY_CHANGE_DETECTED and INSTRUCTION from the summary outputs. It prints the acknowledge-breaks message, plus the instruction when one is set, only when a change was detected; any other failure says the Gradle build or check failed, that API compatibility was not established, and points at api-compatibility.log. A script extracts that run block and checks a nonzero exit with no detected change, and the workflow runs it before the JDK setup.

The API compatibility job can fail while Gradle is still resolving dependencies, before any API comparison runs, and still tell the pull request to acknowledge a breaking change. A rerun on another runner often passes, but the failing check blocks the merge with a message that describes an API break. The enforce step treated every remaining nonzero Gradle exit as an incompatible API. It always printed the apiCompatibilityAcknowledgeBreaks instructions and exited 1, and it never looked at whether the summary step had detected an API change, so a build or resolution failure and a real break were reported the same way.

Fixes #508

## Local Validation

No local test ran for `.github/scripts/test-api-compatibility-workflow.py` and `.github/workflows/api-compatibility.yml`: the pre-submission test runner found no Python test target for it.

title: fix(core): give each chart implementation its own name
body:
## Summary

Five charts declared an internal composable with the same name as their public one. Two needed an import to work around it:

- `charts-stacked-area/.../StackedAreaChart.kt` imported `internal.StackedAreaChart` unaliased, which shadowed the public `StackedAreaChart` declared in the same file. The call resolved to the import, so the declaration and its own implementation shared a name and a call-site spelling.
- `charts-stacked-bar/.../StackedBarChart.kt` aliased it as `StackedBarChartInternal`. Neither name was load-bearing, so removing the alias would have compiled while silently changing what the call site meant.

Bar, pie, and radar relied on the package alone to disambiguate. Five charts, three conventions, none documented.

Each implementation is renamed by the role it plays, matching what `charts-line` already did correctly:

| Role | Suffix | Charts |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Canvas, owns the draw call | `ChartContent` | `PieChartContent`, `RadarChartContent` |
| Density mode, zoom, animation, header | `ChartImpl` | `BarChartImpl`, `StackedBarChartImpl`, `StackedAreaChartImpl` |
| Layout shell, no chart state | `ChartFrame` | `PieChartFrame` (was private `PieChartContent`) |

Radar and pie are named `ChartContent` because those charts have no separate state layer — `RadarChartContent` holds its own animation state and draw call in one composable — so the suffix reflects a real difference in layering, not an inconsistent rule.

Files are renamed to match, and `docs/wiki/dev/internals/naming.md` records the public-composable rule, the four role suffixes, all eight call chains, the file-naming table, and the `@InternalChartsApi` boundary rule.

No behaviour change.

title: fix(build): make API compatibility gate squash-merge safe
body:
## Summary

- Fixes #601: the API compatibility baseline pinned a pre-squash commit SHA that never reached `main` after a squash-merge, so a fresh CI checkout could never resolve it.
- `apiCompatibilityCheck` now resolves its own baseline (the latest release tag, falling back to `origin/main` when there is none) instead of reading a pinned SHA from a file. Both `apiCompatibilityCheck` and `apiCompatibilityAcknowledgeBreaks` reject an explicit `-PapiCompatibilityBaselineRef` override, so the diff span and the acknowledgment file always describe the same release cycle.
- `API-COMPATIBILITY-BASELINE.txt` is replaced by `API-COMPATIBILITY-BREAKS.txt`: breaking changes are acknowledged per finding (module/class/member/change-kind) rather than by moving a single pointer, grouped under a heading for the pending release version resolved from Axion. Nothing ever renames a heading by hand -- the next acknowledgment after a tag lands just opens a new section.
- New `apiCompatibilityCompare -PapiCompatibilityBaselineRef=<ref>` task for investigating an arbitrary historical ref; it never touches the acknowledgment file or the pass/fail gate.
- Backfilled the current cycle's real entries: 379 findings, all explained by the `io.github.dautovicharis.charts` -> `io.github.hdcharts.charts` package rename (#579, #521).

title: fix(line): rescale timeline charts as large values leave the window
body:
## Summary
Fixes #599

Timeline line charts kept the widest range they had ever seen, so once a huge value scrolled out of the window the line stayed pinned to the bottom of the plot and the y-axis labels kept describing a range the data no longer had.

- Drop the sticky `timelineRenderMinMax` state. Both the previous and the current window are now normalized with the **current** data range, so the drawn line and the y-axis labels always describe the same range and the chart follows the data down as large values leave the window.
- Only animate a shift when the update really is the window advanced by one point (`isTimelineAdvance`). Data replaced in place morphs instead, because sliding unrelated values across the plot and swapping them at the end animates a change that never happened.
- Give `Timeline` mode a value animation spec matched to its update interval. The longer default spec was cancelled by the next update before it arrived, leaving the line trailing the data.
- Precompute the shift's normalized draw values once per update in `TimelineTransitionData` instead of on every animation frame.

Sample and build changes that support the fix:

- New **Scale drop** line demo (`LineScaleDropDemo` / `LineScaleDropViewModel`) streaming a window that runs in the millions, drops below 100, and climbs back, with a "Scale switch" control, so the rescaling is reproducible by hand.
- Extract the repeated live-update coroutine loop into `LiveTimelineStreamer` and the repeated draft-slider pattern into `DemoSlider` / `DemoRangeSlider`, removing the duplicated versions from the bar, histogram, line, multi-line, stacked-area, stacked-bar, and timeline demos.
- `chartsTestJvm` now also runs `:sample-shared:jvmTest` and `:app:jvmTest`, and the sample app gains a `commonTest` source set with `kotlinx-coroutines-test`.

title: Fix the desktop release packaging job
body:
The `desktop` job in `release.yml` has never actually run. A dry run of it (`make site` on a throwaway branch, no upload) turned up two problems that would each have broken the first release.

### 1. Only the host machine's FFmpeg natives jar was ever built
```
Error: Task failed: Base Configured Inputs for Windows Intel: Input doesn't exist or isn't readable:
  app/desktop/build/ffmpeg-natives/ffmpeg-natives-windows-x86_64.jar
Did you mean: ffmpeg-natives-linux-x86_64.jar
```
Each machine's natives come from an `ffmpegNativesWithoutCliTools*` Zip task. `printConveyorConfig` only prints the jar paths, and `proguardReleaseJars` resolves only the host's classpath, so on the Linux runner only the Linux jar existed. Locally it only works if earlier builds left the other jars in `build/`.

`printConveyorConfig` now depends on all four Zip tasks. Conveyor runs that task on every build, so this covers both CI and local `conveyor make site`. Checked from an empty `build/ffmpeg-natives`: all four jars are built, stderr is empty, and stdout is still pure config.

### 2. `make copied-site` had no GitHub token
Conveyor reads the GitHub Releases token only from `app.site.github.oauth-token` ([uploading docs](https://github.com/hydraulic-software/conveyor/blob/master/guidebook/docs/serving/uploading.md#publishing-through-github)). The job exported `GITHUB_TOKEN`, but nothing mapped it to that key, so the build would have finished and then failed at the upload. Other projects publishing this way (Qodat, MoeListKMP) set the key explicitly.

The token is now passed as `-Kapp.site.github.oauth-token=${{ github.token }}` in `extra_flags`, the same way the Conveyor action passes `app.signing-key`. The unused `GITHUB_TOKEN` env var is removed.

Why not set it in `conveyor.conf`? Both config-file forms break local builds for anyone without a token:
- `site.github.oauth-token = ${?env.GITHUB_TOKEN}` with the variable unset: `No configuration setting found for key 'oauth-token'`.
- An empty-string default: `Key oauth-token cannot be blank.`

`-K` values are literal (no `${env...}` substitution; verified locally), so the workflow expression is the way in. Locally, `conveyor -Kapp.site.github.oauth-token=… json` resolves the key with `copy-to = github:r0adkll/Campfire`. The repo's default workflow token permissions are `write`.

### 3. Contact email
`app.contact-email` is now set, so the `.deb` maintainer reads `The Scavenger's Software <drew@thescavengers.software>` instead of `<nobody@nowhere>`. In the resolved config, this and the Linux contact email are the only values that change.

### Not covered
The upload itself only runs on a real release, including what Conveyor does when the release it uploads to already exists (this job starts from `release: created`, so it always will).

No changelog entry: build and CI only.

title: Fix crashes on Cast route discovery and user requests without a session
body:
Fixes the two fatal crashes on 1.1.0 that are bugs in our code, per Crashlytics.

## Cast route discovery crash

`BadParcelableException: ClassNotFoundException when unmarshalling: com.google.android.gms.cast.CastDevice`, thrown from `MediaRouterCastController.updateDevices` during `onRouteAdded`. This issue is new in 1.1.0.

The Cast provider's route extras contain a parcelled `CastDevice`, and reading any key (here `EXTRA_SESSION_ID`) unparcels the whole bundle. Bundles from the router service use the framework class loader, which can't resolve Play services classes. `GmsCastDevice.getFromBundle` sets the class loader itself, but the session-id filter read the extras before that happened.

- A `castExtras` accessor points the bundle at our class loader. Both extras reads go through it.
- `updateDevices` now catches and logs failures itself. Previously only 2 of its 7 callers did, and the MediaRouter callbacks, which run on the main thread, weren't among them.

## Requests without a logged-in user

`IllegalArgumentException: Required value was null` from `UserSession.requiredUserId`, thrown in the user client's extra-header plugin. It happens when a request outlives its session, e.g. around sign-in or logout. This issue goes back to 0.9.0-beta.

- The extra headers moved into `installUserExtraHeaders`. Without a user, the request goes out with no extra headers.
- `refreshTokens` had the same `required*` calls. It now returns `null` without a user, and reads the user once at the start of the refresh. If the session ends or switches accounts mid-refresh, the rotated token is stored for (or invalidated on) the account it was issued to, not whichever account is current when the response lands.

## Not addressed

Two other 1.1.0 fatals (`NoSuchFieldError: Configuration.fontWeightAdjustment`, and `NoSuchMethodError: setForegroundServiceBehavior` behind an `SDK_INT >= 31` check) come from one device that reports Android 11 while running a minSdk 31 build. That points to an environment misreporting its SDK level, so they need no code change.

## Testing

- `:data:network:impl:jvmTest`: the new `UserClientSessionTest` has 4 tests. With the old logic swapped back in, 3 of them fail with the Crashlytics exception or the wrong-account token. The test fakes and test user moved to a shared `NetworkFakes.kt`.
- `:app:android:compileAlphaDebugKotlin`
- The Cast fix has not been reproduced on a device. `MediaRouterCastController` is Android-only and its module has no unit tests, so the changed-file coverage gate may need `skip-coverage`.

title: Fix edge-to-edge display on Android
body:
Closes #1095

Play flagged two things: deprecated edge-to-edge APIs, and content that may not lay out correctly now that Android 15+ enforces edge-to-edge. Both turned out to be real.

## Deprecated APIs

At targetSdk 37 the platform ignores `android:statusBarColor` / `android:navigationBarColor`, so everything that fed them was dead code — a 2019 copy of Google's insets sample: the `Theme.Campfire.Immerse` style, the scrim colours and light-bar booleans, and the `values-v29` / `values-notnight-v27` qualifiers (both below minSdk 31, so `values-v29` always won anyway). `enableEdgeToEdge()` already calls `setDecorFitsSystemWindows(false)`, so the explicit call in `MainActivity` goes too.

The remaining deprecated-API entries in Play's report (`LAYOUT_IN_DISPLAY_CUTOUT_MODE_SHORT_EDGES`, and the `androidx.glance.appwidget.*` entry points) are inside Glance, not our code — nothing to do there beyond future library bumps.

## Insets

`CampfireWindowInsets` and `CampfireTopAppBarInsets` both ended in `.only(WindowInsetsSides.Vertical)`, discarding the horizontal system-bar inset Material supplies, and neither ever looked at the display cutout. In landscape on a cutout or three-button-nav device, content ran under both. Both also had `if`/`else` branches with byte-identical arms, which is probably how the `.only()` got there.

Restoring the horizontal inset is only half the job, though, because it isn't the same inset for every part of the screen. The second commit works out who owns each window edge:

- The navigation rail (or permanent drawer) already insets the **leading** edge — `NavigationRailDefaults.windowInsets` includes `Start`.
- The supporting pane covers the **trailing** edge whenever it's open.
- The root content owns whichever edge neither of those covers.

Handing every scaffold the window's full horizontal insets instead makes the root content pay for both edges twice and pads the pane away from an edge it never touches. `HorizontalSafeInsets` now routes each side to whatever actually reaches it.

Separately, screens excluded `WindowInsets.navigationBars` wholesale to make room for the in-app bottom bar. In portrait that's right; in landscape it also dropped the side inset the system bar takes. `OverlappedNavigationBarInsets` narrows the exclusion to the bottom edge.

Finally, `ApplyStatusBar` set only `isAppearanceLightStatusBars`. The navigation bar's appearance fell through to `enableEdgeToEdge()`'s default, which reads the **system's** night mode — so anyone running the app in a theme that disagreed with their system setting got navigation buttons that nearly vanished. It now drives both bars from the in-app theme.

## Verification

API 37 emulator, `cutout.emulation.tall` overlay + three-button navigation, portrait and landscape, light and dark app themes, A/B'd against a build of `main` and against the first commit.

The interesting geometry is landscape with the navigation bar on one edge and the display cutout on the other — what a Pixel Fold reports folded shut and rotated, and what the emulator reproduces (nav bar 144px one side, cutout 144px the other):

- **Pane open:** the first commit left an ~85px gap between the content carousel and the pane, and pushed the section headers in by the width of the nav bar the rail already covers. Both are gone.
- **Pane closed:** Library's filter icon clears the system navigation bar, which is the case the first commit fixed and this one preserves.
- **Portrait:** unchanged.
- **Theme mismatch:** a dark app theme on a light system now renders white navigation buttons instead of near-black ones.

title: Fix desktop navigation chrome: bottom bar strip, app bar margin, drawer selection
body:
## Summary

Four desktop UI fixes noticed while using the app at different window sizes.

- **Blank strip under the bottom navigation bar** in phone-width windows. The desktop entry point passed an artificial 24dp bottom inset that the root layout applied as content padding.
- **Search bar flush against the window's top** in rail and drawer layouts. The same artificial inset was only applied in bottom-nav mode, so wide layouts got nothing.
- **Expanded search results spilling past the search bar.** The docked sheet was forced to `content width - 32dp`, but M3 anchors the popup to the collapsed pill's top-left corner and sizes it to the pill, so anything wider grew off to the right (off-screen on smaller windows, off-centre on larger ones).
- **Navigation drawer always highlighting Home.** Selection came from the bottom of the back stack while drawer items push rather than reset.

## Approach

- The desktop top inset now travels through a new `LocalWindowChromeInsets` composition local and is consumed by the app bars (`CampfireSearchAppBar`, `CampfireDockedSearchBar`, and `CampfireTopAppBarInsets`) the same way they consume the status bar inset. It stays inside the app bar's background, so scrolling no longer exposes a blank margin, and the supporting pane starts at the very top. Desktop provides 12dp, which lands the search pill and title-bar titles at the drawer's 16dp margin. Android and iOS provide an empty inset and are unaffected.
- `AdaptiveCampfireLayout` no longer takes `windowInsets`/`hideBottomNav`; its scaffold reserves nothing.
- `ExpandedDockedSearchBar` uses the search bar state's own bounds.
- `CampfireDrawer` derives its selection from the top-most non-detail screen, with an exact match preferred so Settings and Downloads (both `SettingsScreen`) don't light up together. The permanent drawer now calls `resetRoot` like the bottom bar and rail instead of stacking destinations. This also applies to XL Android tablets, where back after picking a drawer item now exits, matching the existing rail/bottom-bar behaviour.

## Verification

Checked in the running desktop app via the Compose hot-reload semantic tree at 1800dp (drawer), 800dp (rail), and 420dp (bottom nav):

| Layout | Search pill top | Drawer header top | Content / supporting pane top |
|---|---|---|---|
| Drawer (1800dp) | 16dp | 16dp | 0dp |
| Phone (420dp) | 16dp | n/a | 0dp, bottom bar flush with window bottom |
| Settings title bar | title centre 44dp (same as pill centre) | | 0dp |

Expanded search sheet at 1800dp: x=940px, width 1440px, identical to the collapsed pill (was 1816px wide). Drawer selection verified for Settings, Downloads, Home, and the modal drawer on phone width.

UI-only changes with no unit test coverage, hence `skip-coverage`.

On HLS-capable servers (introduced in #1004) the item detail's trailing button slot was forced visible for every download state, and fell back to a plain download button whenever the play-options dropdown was excluded. That produced:

title: Sleep timer: customizable log-curve fade-out, pause with playback, fade/resume fixes
body:
Closes #1049
Closes #1050
Closes #1048

## What

- **Logarithmic fade curve** (#1050): `VolumeFadeController` now drives the gain from elapsed wall time along a dB-linear (exponential) curve, sweeping 40 dB before snapping to silence. Perceived loudness halves roughly every quarter of the fade, so it sounds even across the whole duration instead of sitting near full volume and dropping off in the last second. Being time-based also means a slow or delayed tick can no longer stretch the fade past its duration.
- **Customizable fade-out duration** (#1049): new `SleepSettings.fadeOutDuration` (default 5s, range 0–60s, 0 = pause immediately) with a slider at the top of Settings → Sleep. `CoroutineSleepTimerManager` passes it through to `fadeToPause`. End-of-chapter timers still pause immediately as before.
- **Sleep timer pauses with playback** (#1048): the epoch countdown was a bare `delay()` that ignored playback state, so it ran out while paused and "faded" an already-paused player. The manager now observes `player.state` for the life of the timer: the countdown runs only while `Playing`, freezes on pause, and resumes where it left off. `RunningTimer` gains `pausedAt` plus a `remainingMillis(now)` helper; both `RunningTimerText` copies and the widget chronometer use it and show the frozen value while paused.
- **Fade vs. resume** (#1048): `pause()`/`playPause()` never touched the fade job, so pressing play mid-fade resumed at reduced volume and then paused again seconds later, and shake-to-reset mid-fade re-armed the timer but still let the fade pause playback. The manager now tracks the fade job: a new timer, a shake reset, or clearing the timer cancels it; the fade restores its start volume on cancellation; and a `Paused → Playing` transition during the fade cancels it (buffering blips are ignored).
- **Auto rewind after auto sleep never fired for timed timers** (found while verifying #1048): `endTimer` nulled `playbackTimer` synchronously but the rewind lambda read it when the fade *completed*, so the check always failed. The ended timer is captured up front now, and the rewind only runs when the fade completes normally.

## Notes

- The 40 dB floor is a deliberate middle ground: a 60 dB sweep front-loads the drop and leaves a long near-silent tail, while 40 dB keeps every quarter of the fade audibly distinct.
- All of the #1048 work lives in the common `CoroutineSleepTimerManager`; no per-platform player changes were needed.
- Analytics event `sleep_fade_out_duration` added for the new setting.
- Adds `FakeSleepSettings` to `:features:settings:test`, and `FakeAudioPlayer` now keeps the jobs it hands out from `fadeToPause`.

## Verification

- `VolumeFadeControllerTest` (8 tests): curve shape, monotonic decrease, midpoint attenuation, zero-duration pause, volume restore after pause and after cancellation, coarse-tick overrun.
- `CoroutineSleepTimerManagerTest` (8 tests, jvmTest since the Android `ShakeDetector` needs a `Context`): countdown ends with the configured fade, pause freezes / resume continues, timer set while paused waits for playback, resume mid-fade cancels the fade (buffering ignored), new timer / clear mid-fade cancels the fade, auto rewind fires on completed fade and not on a cancelled one, end-of-chapter pauses immediately.
- `:infra:audioplayer:impl:jvmTest`, `:features:settings:impl:jvmTest`, `:app:desktop:compileKotlin`, `:app:android:compileAlphaDebugKotlin` all green; ktlint clean.
